data.name: 0 disables auto-ban entirely, even with the box above ticked.

data.name: 0 emits no expiry at all, which is the safe default: an expiry is a promise about mail already in flight, and a window shorter than the delay a retry, a greylist or a mailing list adds costs the message its DKIM pass and its DMARC alignment at the far end. 604800 is a week, the usual choice for a sender who wants one. A signing timestamp is always sent regardless of this value.
data.value: 0 表示完全不发出到期时间，这是安全的默认值：到期时间是对已在传输途中的邮件所作的承诺，而只要这个窗口短于重试、灰名单或邮件列表所增加的延迟，邮件就会在对端失去 DKIM 通过和 DMARC 对齐。604800 是一周，是希望设置到期时间的发件方通常的选择。无论此值为何，签名时间戳都始终会发送。

data.name: 0 is a real answer, not a disabled one - it keeps everything, which is what an administrator collecting evidence wants. Everything else is a promise to the disk.
data.value: 0 是一个真实的答案，而不是“已禁用”——它会保留全部内容，这正是收集证据的管理员想要的。其余任何值都是对磁盘作出的承诺。

data.name: 0 is the shipped default and disables the whole mechanism.
data.value: 0 是出厂默认值，会禁用整个机制。

data.name: 0 is the shipped default and preserves today's behaviour exactly. 1 never delivers unscanned mail.
data.value: 0 是出厂默认值，完全保持当前的行为。1 则绝不投递未经扫描的邮件。

data.name: 0 is the shipped default. 2 is a reasonable start: a mistyped password costs a person two seconds once, and a password-spraying client two, four, six... seconds per guess. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 0 是出厂默认值。2 是一个合理的起点：密码输错一次只会让人多等两秒，而对密码喷洒的客户端来说，每猜一次要等两秒、四秒、六秒……。需要重启服务后生效。

data.name: 0 means archives are never deleted. Retention runs on the server after every backup into this folder - scheduled or started by hand with Start backup now - and only once the new archive has been written and verified readable, so a failed backup never deletes anything. The newest archive is never deleted, the age limit always leaves the two newest alone, and only this server's own HMBackup archives are counted - other files in the folder are never touched.
data.value: 0 表示永不删除存档。每次备份到此文件夹之后 - 无论是计划备份还是用“立即开始备份”手动启动的 - 服务器都会执行保留清理，并且只有在新存档写入完毕并验证可读之后才会执行，因此失败的备份绝不会删除任何内容。最新的存档永不删除，按存留期限清理时始终会保留最新的两个，而且只统计本服务器自己的 HMBackup 存档 - 该文件夹中的其他文件绝不会被触碰。

data.name: 0 means the connection is dropped but no range is created, so the address is not actually banned.
data.value: 0 表示连接会被断开，但不会创建任何范围，因此该地址实际上并未被封禁。

data.name: 0 switches the schedule off, which is the default and is what every existing installation stays at. Values between 1 and 14 are treated as 15, and anything over a week as a week. This one needs a service restart: the task is registered when the server starts.
data.value: 0 会关闭该计划，这是默认值，所有现有安装都保持此设置。1 到 14 之间的值按 15 处理，超过一周的值按一周处理。此项需要重启服务：该任务是在服务器启动时注册的。

data.value: 存在一条 TXT 记录，但无法从本机读取暂存的私钥文件（{0}），因此无法把该记录与密钥进行比对。请在服务器本机上运行此检查，或者取消轮换并从此处重新开始。

data.name: A ceiling on one pass, so a search base pointed one level too high cannot be answered by reading an entire forest. If it is hit, the run says so and disables nothing at all - beyond the limit, an entry that exists is indistinguishable from one that was deleted.
data.value: 对单次遍历的上限，这样即使搜索基准点设得高了一层，也不会靠读取整片林来完成。一旦触及该上限，本次运行会予以说明，并且不会禁用任何内容 - 超出上限之后，存在的条目与已被删除的条目无从区分。

data.name: A certificate has been issued into {0}, but its expiry could not be read: {1}
data.value: 已向 {0} 颁发证书，但无法读取它的到期时间：{1}

data.name: A certificate is issued and valid until {0}, {1} days from now. Renewal starts automatically inside the last {2} days.
data.value: 证书已颁发，有效期至 {0}，距今 {1} 天。续期会在最后 {2} 天内自动开始。

data.name: A code from an authenticator app, required alongside this account's password. It applies where a code can actually be entered - the Control Panel and the API. Mail clients cannot present one, so once this is on they must use an app password instead.
data.value: 来自身份验证器应用的验证码，需与此账户的密码一并使用。它适用于确实能够输入验证码的场合 - 控制面板和 API。邮件客户端无法出示验证码，因此一旦启用此项，它们就必须改用应用密码。

data.name: A credential is set but the listener has no TLS, so the credential crosses the network in clear text on every scrape and can be replayed by anyone on the path. Set the certificate and key files, or bind to 127.0.0.1. The server still starts - it logs this same warning.
data.value: 已设置凭据，但监听器没有 TLS，因此凭据会在每次抓取时以明文穿越网络，路径上的任何人都可以重放它。请设置证书和密钥文件，或者绑定到 127.0.0.1。服务器仍会启动 - 它会记录这条同样的警告。

data.name: A custom virus scanner or external tool that hangs - bounded by ExternalProcessTimeout.
data.value: 会挂起的自定义病毒扫描器或外部工具 - 由 ExternalProcessTimeout 限定。

data.name: A domain hosted on this server
data.value: 本服务器上托管的一个域

data.name: A domain name here needs the SERVER's own computer to be joined to that domain, because Windows validates it with LogonUser. From a computer that is not joined, every attempt fails as though the password were wrong - including when the domain name is simply misspelt - so a mailbox configured this way on an unjoined server can never log in and never says why. If the server is not domain-joined, use LDAP directory authentication on the Directory authentication page instead: it binds to the directory over the network and needs no domain join.
data.value: 在此处填写域名，要求服务器本机加入该域，因为 Windows 是用 LogonUser 来验证的。在未加入域的计算机上，每一次尝试都会像密码错误一样失败 - 包括仅仅是域名拼写有误的情况 - 因此在未加入域的服务器上这样配置的邮箱永远无法登录，也永远不会说明原因。如果服务器未加入域，请改用“目录身份验证”页上的 LDAP 目录身份验证：它通过网络绑定到目录，不需要加入域。

data.name: A group exists so that several accounts can be given the same rights at once - grant the group access to a public folder under Public folders, and every account listed here gets that access. An empty group grants nothing to anyone.
data.value: 设立组是为了一次性给若干账户授予相同的权限 - 在“公用文件夹”中把某个公用文件夹的访问权限授予该组，此处列出的每个账户就都获得该访问权限。空组不会给任何人授予任何权限。

data.name: A key rotation is staged (selector "{0}"). The staged record and the promote step are managed from the domain's DKIM tab, which gates promotion on its own DNS check; it is deliberately not repeated here.
data.value: 已暂存一次密钥轮换（选择器 "{0}"）。暂存的记录和提升步骤在该域的 DKIM 选项卡中管理，那里会以自身的 DNS 检查作为提升的前提；此处刻意不重复这些操作。

data.name: A key with a domain list is also refused the delivery-queue endpoints, because the queue is server-wide and cannot be filtered by domain.
data.value: 带有域列表的密钥同样会被拒绝访问投递队列端点，因为队列是服务器范围的，无法按域过滤。

data.name: A label is required. It is how this key is told apart from the others months from now.
data.value: 必须填写标签。几个月之后，正是靠它把这个密钥与其他密钥区分开。

data.name: A low rate on a busy server usually means the TTL is shorter than the interval between lookups of the same object; a rate of 0% with no memory in use means nothing has been looked up yet, which is not the same thing. Memory in use is measured against the size caps above, and a cache at its cap is evicting entries it would otherwise have kept.
data.value: 在繁忙的服务器上命中率偏低，通常意味着 TTL 短于对同一对象两次查询之间的间隔；而命中率为 0% 且没有占用内存，则表示还没有查询过任何内容，这是两回事。占用的内存是相对于上面的容量上限来衡量的，达到上限的缓存会逐出本来可以保留的条目。

data.name: A mail server usually starts with the rest of the machine, and on a machine where the database service starts second, the first few attempts fail. Together with the delay below this is the whole window: six attempts five seconds apart is half a minute. Lengthen it rather than delaying the service if the database is on another host that is slower to come up.
data.value: 邮件服务器通常随机器的其余部分一起启动，而在数据库服务较晚启动的机器上，最初几次尝试会失败。它与下面的延迟共同构成整个窗口：每隔五秒尝试一次、共六次，就是半分钟。如果数据库位于另一台启动较慢的主机上，请延长它，而不是延迟服务本身。

data.name: A marked message is changed in no visible way: no X-hMailServer-Spam header, no reason header and no subject prefix, so a mail client has nothing to file on. The internal spam flag is still set, which suppresses auto-replies and forwarding for accounts configured that way.
data.value: 被标记的邮件在外观上不会有任何变化：没有 X-hMailServer-Spam 标头，没有原因标头，也没有主题前缀，因此邮件客户端无从据以归类。内部的垃圾邮件标志仍会设置，这会对做了相应配置的账户抑制自动回复和转发。

data.name: A message above this is passed without being sent to the engine. Posting a fifty-megabyte attachment across the network to be told it is not spam costs more than the answer is worth. 0 removes the ceiling, which is reasonable for an engine on this machine.
data.value: 超过此大小的邮件会直接放行，不再送交引擎。把五十兆字节的附件通过网络送过去，只为得到“不是垃圾邮件”的结论，代价大于这个答案的价值。0 表示取消该上限，对于运行在本机上的引擎这是合理的。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is marked as spam and delivered. Nothing is refused on score.
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被标记为垃圾邮件并投递。不会因分数而拒收任何邮件。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is marked as spam and delivered; {1} or more is refused (550 before the body, 554 after it).
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被标记为垃圾邮件并投递；达到 {1} 或以上的会被拒收（正文之前为 550，之后为 554）。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is refused (550 before the body, 554 after it). Nothing is marked.
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被拒收（正文之前为 550，之后为 554）。不会标记任何邮件。

data.name: A message to ten local mailboxes is written once and linked ten times rather than copied ten times, which is the difference between one disk write and ten for a large message to a distribution list. Needs the data directory on NTFS; where a link cannot be made the server copies the file and says so in the SMTP log. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 发给十个本地邮箱的邮件只写入一次并建立十个链接，而不是复制十份；对于发往分发列表的大邮件来说，这就是一次磁盘写入与十次磁盘写入的区别。需要数据目录位于 NTFS 上；在无法建立链接的地方，服务器会复制文件并在 SMTP 日志中说明。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: A modern administration app for hMailServer: live dashboard, domains and accounts, delivery queue, log streaming, full server settings and the 6.x transport-security features (DANE, MTA-STS, ARC, TLS-RPT, ACME).
data.value: 面向 hMailServer 的现代管理应用：实时仪表板、域与账户、投递队列、日志流、完整的服务器设置，以及 6.x 的传输安全功能（DANE、MTA-STS、ARC、TLS-RPT、ACME）。

data.name: A new service account password has been typed AND "remove the stored password" is ticked. Untick one of them - guessing which was meant is not this page's decision to make.
data.value: 既输入了新的服务账户密码，又勾选了“删除已存储的密码”。请取消其中之一 - 猜测您的本意不是本页应当作出的决定。

data.name: A notice is sent to the envelope sender of every infected message. Virus senders forge that address almost without exception, so this mostly delivers mail to people who did not send anything — which is backscatter, and it is what gets a server onto a block list.
data.value: 会向每一封受感染邮件的信封发件人发送通知。病毒发送方几乎无一例外地伪造该地址，因此这多半只是把邮件投递给什么都没发过的人 — 这就是反向散射，也正是让服务器进入阻止列表的原因。

data.name: A one-time code required in addition to the administrator password, checked by the SERVER - so it applies to every client of that credential: this Control Panel, scripts using the COM API, and the REST API (which reads the code from an X-hMailServer-OTP header). The secret is stored on the server, in hMailServer.ini, machine-protected. It makes the administrator password worthless on its own. Keep the setup key safe: if the authenticator is lost, a local administrator clears AdministratorTotpSecret from hMailServer.ini to recover.
data.value: 除管理员密码之外还需要的一次性验证码，由服务器校验 - 因此它适用于该凭据的每一个客户端：本控制面板、使用 COM API 的脚本，以及 REST API（后者从 X-hMailServer-OTP 标头读取验证码）。该机密存储在服务器上的 hMailServer.ini 中，受计算机级保护。它使管理员密码本身不再足以登录。请妥善保管设置密钥：如果身份验证器丢失，需要由本地管理员从 hMailServer.ini 中清除 AdministratorTotpSecret 来恢复。

data.name: A passphrase is already stored for '{0}'. Saving replaces it - the old one cannot be recovered from here. Replace it?
data.value: '{0}' 已存储了一个密码短语。保存会将其替换 - 旧的密码短语无法从此处恢复。是否替换？

data.name: A passphrase is stored for this certificate. It is never displayed here - saving a new one replaces it. Whether it is the RIGHT passphrase is only proven when the server loads the key: after the next restart, check the application error log.
data.value: 此证书已存储了密码短语。它绝不会在此显示 - 保存新的会替换旧的。它是否为正确的密码短语，只有在服务器加载密钥时才能证明：请在下次重启之后查看应用程序错误日志。

data.name: A passphrase is stored, but the key file is not encrypted, so it is never used. Harmless - it simply does nothing.
data.value: 已存储密码短语，但密钥文件并未加密，因此它从不会被使用。这没有害处 - 只是不起任何作用。

data.name: A password is stored - leave blank to keep it
data.value: 已存储密码 - 留空则保持不变

data.name: A quota can be set on the domain and overridden per account.
data.value: 可以在域上设置配额，并在账户上逐个覆盖。

data.name: A random server-wide secret
data.value: 服务器范围内的一个随机机密

data.name: A random token Prometheus will present on every scrape
data.value: Prometheus 在每次抓取时出示的随机令牌

data.name: A reachable directory server. The hMailServer machine must reach the host above on the effective port (636 for LDAPS, 389 otherwise) through any firewall in between. A DMZ host usually needs a rule added for exactly this.
data.value: 一台可访问的目录服务器。hMailServer 所在的计算机必须能够穿过中间的任何防火墙，在有效端口（LDAPS 为 636，其余为 389）上访问上面的主机。DMZ 中的主机通常正需要为此添加一条规则。

data.name: A recipient domain with several MX hosts is worth more attempts than one with a single host, because a retry can land on a different server. This multiplies the retry count above by the number of MX hosts actually tried.
data.value: 拥有多台 MX 主机的收件人域值得多尝试几次，因为重试可能落到另一台服务器上。此项会把上面的重试次数乘以实际尝试过的 MX 主机数。

data.name: A remote server that answers extremely slowly. The idle timeout is re-armed on every byte, so a host that sends one byte occasionally used to hold a delivery thread indefinitely; ClientSessionCeiling (30 minutes by default) is the absolute ceiling, armed once and never re-armed.
data.value: 应答极其缓慢的远程服务器。空闲超时会在每个字节到达时重新计时，因此偶尔发送一个字节的主机过去可以无限期占用一个投递线程；ClientSessionCeiling（默认 30 分钟）是绝对上限，只计时一次，绝不重新计时。

data.name: A reply for the whole domain - a closed office, a decommissioned department. It answers only for accounts that have NO vacation message of their own: an account's own message always wins, and at most one reply answers any message.
data.value: 面向整个域的回复 - 例如关闭的办公室、撤销的部门。它只为没有自己的休假回复的账户作答：账户自己的回复始终优先，而且对任何一封邮件最多只有一条回复。

data.name: A rotation is already staged. If the DNS record is published, press "Check DNS"; promoting unlocks once the check passes in this session.
data.value: 已经暂存了一次轮换。如果 DNS 记录已发布，请按“检查 DNS”；只有在本次会话中检查通过之后，提升操作才会解锁。

data.name: A route overrides MX lookup for named domains.
data.value: 路由会为指定的域覆盖 MX 查询。

data.name: A scan that errors, times out or cannot reach its engine is not a clean verdict - nobody looked. The shipped behaviour is to deliver the message anyway, which is what this server has always done; holding it instead is the stricter choice and the one to make deliberately.
data.value: 出错、超时或者连不上引擎的扫描不是一个明确的结论 - 等于没有人看过。出厂行为是照常投递该邮件，这也是本服务器一贯的做法；改为暂挂它是更严格的选择，需要有意为之。

data.name: A scanner that cannot run does not refuse the message. The error is written to the log and the scan continues to the next scanner; when none of them can answer, the message is treated exactly as if it had been examined and found clean. That is why this page reports whether each scanner can run rather than whether it is switched on.
data.value: 无法运行的扫描器并不会拒收邮件。错误会写入日志，扫描继续交给下一个扫描器；当所有扫描器都无法作答时，该邮件会被完全当作已经检查过且未发现问题来处理。这正是本页报告每个扫描器是否能够运行、而不是报告它是否被打开的原因。

data.name: A schedule creates and updates accounts with nobody watching. It never disables one, whatever the checkbox above is set to - departures are left to a person who has read a preview. Switch this on only after a preview has told you what it is going to do.
data.value: 计划会在无人看管的情况下创建和更新账户。无论上面的复选框如何设置，它都绝不会禁用账户 - 人员离职留给已经看过预览的人来处理。请只在预览已经告诉您它将要做什么之后，再打开此项。

data.name: A schedule is configured: daily at {0:00}:{1:00}, server local time.
data.value: 已配置计划：每天 {0:00}:{1:00}，服务器本地时间。

data.name: A schedule is configured: one backup every {0} minute(s).
data.value: 已配置计划：每 {0} 分钟备份一次。

data.name: A second factor is enforced on the administrator credential, on every client.
data.value: 已在管理员凭据上、对每一个客户端强制启用第二重验证。

data.name: A second factor is enrolled. Every sign-in with the administrator credential - this tool, the COM API and the REST API - needs a code. Enter a current code to turn it off.
data.value: 已注册第二重验证。使用管理员凭据的每一次登录 - 本工具、COM API 和 REST API - 都需要验证码。请输入一个当前的验证码以将其关闭。

data.name: A second factor is enrolled. This account's own password no longer signs in to mail clients - only its app passwords do. Removing the second factor restores it.
data.value: 已注册第二重验证。此账户自身的密码不再能登录邮件客户端 - 只有它的应用密码可以。删除第二重验证会恢复原状。

data.name: A secret is configured — leave blank to keep it
data.value: 已配置机密 — 留空则保持不变

data.name: A separate ceiling from the time limit, because a search that reads enormous amounts of message content is expensive even when it finishes quickly.
data.value: 与时间限制分开的另一个上限，因为读取大量邮件内容的搜索即使很快完成，代价也很高。

data.name: A separate password for one mail client. Losing a laptop then means revoking one line here, rather than changing the account password and reconfiguring every other client.
data.value: 供一个邮件客户端单独使用的密码。这样，丢失一台笔记本电脑只需在此撤销一行，而不必更改账户密码并重新配置其他所有客户端。

data.name: A service account password is stored in hMailServer.INI in plain text - the DPAPI setting does not cover it, because the registration step has nowhere else to read it from. Now that the service has been registered, Windows keeps its own copy, so clear the value on the Server limits & expert settings page. A virtual account (NT SERVICE\hMailServer) or a group managed service account avoids the question entirely.
data.value: 服务账户密码以明文形式存储在 hMailServer.INI 中 - DPAPI 设置并不涵盖它，因为注册步骤没有别的地方可以读取它。既然服务已经注册，Windows 会自行保留一份副本，因此请在“服务器限制与专家设置”页上清除该值。使用虚拟账户（NT SERVICE\hMailServer）或组托管服务账户可以彻底避免这个问题。

data.name: A short built-in list - "password", "123456", "changeme" and about thirty more - compared without regard to case. It is deliberately not a "top 10000" list, which would need a data file and an update path; it catches the passwords that get typed while setting up a mailbox nobody comes back to.
data.value: 一份简短的内置列表 - "password"、"123456"、"changeme" 以及另外三十来个 - 比较时不区分大小写。它有意不是“前 10000 名”那种列表，那需要一个数据文件和一条更新途径；它拦截的是在建立一个此后无人再管的邮箱时随手输入的那些密码。

data.name: A simple bind needs the user's distinguished name. There are two ways to get one - search for it, or compute it from a template - and Negotiate needs neither, because SSPI authenticates by user name and domain, which the account already carries.
data.value: 简单绑定需要用户的可分辨名称。获取它有两种方式 - 搜索，或者按模板推算 - 而 Negotiate 两者都不需要，因为 SSPI 是按用户名和域进行身份验证的，而账户本身就带着这些信息。

data.name: A single DNS query. 0 = no bound.
data.value: 单次 DNS 查询。0 = 不限制。

data.name: A successful logon clears the name's counters, and attempts made while it is locked are not counted - so an attacker cannot hold a mailbox locked indefinitely with a trickle of guesses.
data.value: 一次成功登录会清除该名称的计数器，而锁定期间的尝试不计入计数 - 因此攻击者无法靠涓滴式的猜测把一个邮箱无限期地锁住。

data.name: A triplet that has been seen before but has not yet been confirmed sits in a window before its record expires. Turning this off lets mail through during that window instead of greylisting it again, which is gentler on senders that retry slowly and weaker against a sender that retries once.
data.value: 此前见过、但尚未确认的三元组会在其记录到期之前处于一个窗口期内。关闭此项会让该窗口期内的邮件直接通过，而不是再次以灰名单拦截，这对重试较慢的发件方更友好，对只重试一次的发件方则防护更弱。

data.name: A v=STSv1 record is live at {0} with id {1}. The id being different from the suggestion is fine - it is yours to choose; change it whenever the policy changes.
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=STSv1 记录处于生效状态，id 为 {1}。该 id 与建议值不同没有关系 - 它由您自己决定；每当策略变更时更改它即可。

data.name: A v=TLSRPTv1 record is live at {0} and its reports go to {1}.
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=TLSRPTv1 记录处于生效状态，其报告发送至 {1}。

data.name: A v=TLSRPTv1 record is live at {0} with rua={1} - a different report mailbox than the one above, which is fine as long as it exists and is read. Published: {2}
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=TLSRPTv1 记录处于生效状态，rua={1} - 与上面的报告邮箱不同，只要它确实存在并且有人查看，这就没有问题。发布时间：{2}

data.name: A version older than 6.2.17; upgrade, because that is the version that added these lines.
data.value: 早于 6.2.17 的版本；请升级，因为正是该版本添加了这些行。

data.name: A virus scanner that stops responding. ClamAV is contacted after the message is accepted, so a wedged clamd shows up as accepted-but-never-delivered. Each socket operation is bounded by ClamMinTimeout / ClamMaxTimeout - a deadline on one read or write, armed afresh each time, so a large message streamed in chunks can take longer than ClamMaxTimeout in total.
data.value: 停止响应的病毒扫描器。ClamAV 是在邮件被接受之后才联系的，因此卡死的 clamd 表现为“已接受但始终未投递”。每一次套接字操作都受 ClamMinTimeout / ClamMaxTimeout 限定 - 那是对单次读或写的期限，每次重新计时，因此分块传输的大邮件总耗时可能超过 ClamMaxTimeout。

data.value: 同时在操作系统的防火墙中阻止被封禁的地址

data.value: 目录条目消失时同时把账户标记为非活动(_I)

data.value: 同时要求安装程序具有有效的 Authenticode 签名

data.name: Also turned off by a limit of 0 below, whatever this box says.
data.value: 无论此复选框如何设置，下面的限制为 0 也会将其关闭。

data.name: Alternative domain names treated as this domain. Mail sent to user@alias is delivered to user@{0}.
data.value: 被视为本域的备用域名。发往 user@alias 的邮件会投递到 user@{0}。

data.name: An IPv4 address, and the credential gate: anywhere in 127.0.0.0/8 the endpoints are open to this machine without authentication, exactly as before. On any other address /metrics answers 503 until a credential below is set - the exposition includes queue depth, session counts and version numbers, so it must not be network-readable unauthenticated.
data.value: 一个 IPv4 地址，以及凭据这道门槛：在 127.0.0.0/8 内的任何地址上，这些端点对本机开放且无需身份验证，与以往完全相同。在其他任何地址上，/metrics 会返回 503，直到设置了下面的凭据为止 - 因为其输出包含队列深度、会话数和版本号，绝不能在未经身份验证的情况下从网络读取。

data.name: An OnAcceptMessage event script, or the database.
data.value: 一个 OnAcceptMessage 事件脚本，或者数据库。

data.name: An SPF record is live at {0} and it is not the suggested one. That may well be deliberate - the suggestion cannot know your other senders. Published: {1} — just confirm everything that really sends mail as {0} is covered.
data.value: {0} 上有一条 SPF 记录处于生效状态，而且它不是建议的那一条。这很可能是有意为之 - 建议值无从知晓您的其他发件源。发布时间：{1} — 只需确认真正以 {0} 名义发信的一切都已被涵盖。

data.name: An account can be switched off without deleting it, which keeps the mail and refuses new logons.
data.value: 账户可以在不删除的情况下关闭，这样既保留邮件，又拒绝新的登录。

data.name: An alias points one address at another without needing a second mailbox.
data.value: 别名可以把一个地址指向另一个地址，而无需第二个邮箱。

data.name: An archive is usually kept for a legal or contractual reason, and that reason usually applies to particular domains rather than to every domain this server hosts. With a list here a message is archived only when its local sender or one of its recipients belongs to a listed domain, and only the copies for listed domains are made - a listed recipient still gets their copy when the sender's domain is not listed. Matched without regard to case. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 保留存档通常出于法律或合同上的原因，而该原因通常只涉及特定的域，而不是本服务器托管的所有域。此处填写列表之后，只有当邮件的本地发件人或某个收件人属于列出的域时，该邮件才会被存档，而且只会生成列出的域所对应的副本 - 即使发件人的域未被列出，列出的收件人仍会得到自己的那一份。匹配时不区分大小写。需要重启服务后生效。

data.name: An authenticated session may only send as an address its account owns or has been granted
data.value: 已通过身份验证的会话只能以其账户拥有或被授权的地址发信

data.name: An auto-ban is enforced by the server's own listeners: the address is accepted by the operating system, handed to the server and dropped. These settings push the ban down into the operating system's firewall, hand it to a program of yours, and name the addresses that must never be banned at all. All three apply after a service restart.
data.value: 自动封禁由服务器自身的监听器执行：操作系统接受该地址的连接，交给服务器，再由服务器断开。这些设置把封禁下推到操作系统的防火墙，交给您指定的程序，并指定绝不能被封禁的地址。三项都在服务重启后生效。

data.name: An entire outbound delivery session. 0 = no bound.
data.value: 整个出站投递会话。0 = 不限制。

data.name: An event script runs inside the server with the service account's rights, so what it may instantiate is a security decision rather than a convenience. As shipped this is *, which allows any object, so that upgrading never breaks a script an installation already runs - it is the setting to narrow, not the safe state. Name only what a script of yours actually needs - a scripting file system object, an HTTP client - and everything else is refused with the object's name in the error log; empty refuses everything beyond hMailServer's own objects. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 事件脚本在服务器内部以服务账户的权限运行，因此它可以实例化什么是一项安全决定，而不是一件图方便的事。出厂设置为 *，即允许任何对象，这样升级永远不会弄坏某个安装环境已经在运行的脚本 - 这是一个应当收窄的设置，而不是安全状态。只写下您的脚本确实需要的东西 - 一个脚本文件系统对象、一个 HTTP 客户端 - 其余一切都会被拒绝，并把对象的名称记入错误日志；留空则拒绝 hMailServer 自己的对象以外的一切。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: An external scanner process. 0 = no bound.
data.value: 一个外部扫描器进程。0 = 不限制。

data.name: An older, weaker option: a one-time code asked for after the password when signing in to THIS Control Panel, checked by the tool itself after the server has already accepted the password. The secret is stored per machine under HKLM, so enabling or disabling it needs local administrator rights, and it does nothing for the REST API or for scripts using the COM API. Prefer the server-enforced factor above; this one remains for existing setups.
data.value: 一个较旧、较弱的选项：在登录本控制面板时于密码之后询问的一次性验证码，由该工具自身在服务器已经接受密码之后进行校验。该机密按计算机存储在 HKLM 下，因此启用或禁用它需要本地管理员权限，而且它对 REST API 和使用 COM API 的脚本毫无作用。请优先使用上面由服务器强制执行的第二重验证；此项仅为现有配置保留。

data.name: An override replaces the global ceilings for that address; 0:0 exempts it entirely. Without the optional :hours the override uses the global period. A malformed line is ignored with a log entry and the global limit still applies to that account. Comment lines in this INI section are not shown here and are dropped if the list is saved.
data.value: 覆盖项会为该地址替换全局上限；0:0 则完全豁免它。若省略可选的 :hours，覆盖项将使用全局周期。格式错误的行会被忽略并记入日志，该账户仍适用全局限制。此 INI 节中的注释行不会在此显示，并且在保存该列表时会被丢弃。

data.name: Anti-pounding: a host that reconnects the instant it is dropped can do so thousands of times a minute, and holding the socket open slows it to one connection per interval without costing this server a thread. The connection is held by a timer, so it consumes nothing while it waits.
data.value: 防连击：一台一被断开就立即重连的主机，每分钟可以重连数千次，而保持套接字打开可以把它压到每个间隔一次连接，同时不占用本服务器的线程。该连接由计时器持有，因此等待期间不消耗任何资源。

data.name: Applied when a password is CHOSEN - here, in the account editor, by a script or by the API - and never when one is checked at logon. That distinction is the whole design: an account whose password predates the policy keeps working, because locking people out of mailboxes they can open today is a worse outcome than the weak password it would be correcting. Tightening these settings therefore affects the next password each person sets, not the one they have. Everything is off until you turn it on, so an upgrade never starts refusing passwords on its own.
data.value: 在“选择”密码时应用 - 在此处、在账户编辑器中、由脚本或由 API 选择时 - 而在登录校验密码时从不应用。这个区分正是整个设计的核心：密码早于该策略的账户可以继续使用，因为把人们锁在他们今天还能打开的邮箱之外，比它所要纠正的弱密码是更糟的结果。因此，收紧这些设置影响的是每个人下一次设置的密码，而不是他们现在用的这个。所有项在您打开之前都是关闭的，因此升级绝不会自行开始拒绝密码。

data.name: ArchiveDir is a raw copy of every message that passes through the server, and until now nothing ever removed anything from it - so on a busy server it is a directory that only grows, and the administrator who finds out is the one whose disk filled up. This prunes it. 0 keeps everything, and that is the default on purpose: an archive is usually kept for a legal or contractual reason, and a server that started deleting from one on upgrade would be destroying exactly what it was told to keep. The sweep only ever removes .eml files, so anything else you keep in the archive is left alone, and it runs at startup and every twelve hours after. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: ArchiveDir 保存的是经过服务器的每一封邮件的原始副本，而直到现在都没有任何机制从中删除任何东西 - 因此在繁忙的服务器上，它是一个只增不减的目录，而发现这一点的管理员往往就是磁盘被写满的那一位。此项会对它进行清理。0 表示保留全部，而且这是刻意为之的默认值：保留存档通常出于法律或合同上的原因，而一台在升级后开始从中删除内容的服务器，恰恰会销毁它被要求保留的东西。清理只会删除 .eml 文件，因此您在存档中保存的其他内容不会被动；它在启动时运行，此后每十二小时运行一次。需要重启服务后生效。

data.name: Between the 354 and the 250 the server runs the accept pipeline - spam tests, message modifications, archiving, the OnAcceptMessage script and the database save - on a bounded pool of threads, and replies only when it finishes. The log times each stage. Read it as a sequence and look for the last line written: the stage that is stuck is the one after it. Two stages announce themselves with a start line (spam-protection and script/save); message modifications do not, so a stall there shows as "done spam-protection" followed by silence. A stage taking ten seconds or more is logged at application level even without debug logging.
data.value: 在 354 和 250 之间，服务器会在一个有上限的线程池上运行接受管道 - 垃圾邮件测试、邮件修改、存档、OnAcceptMessage 脚本和数据库保存 - 并且只在完成后才应答。日志会记录每个阶段的耗时。请把它当作一个序列来读，找出最后写入的那一行：卡住的阶段就是它之后的那个。有两个阶段会用一行开始行宣告自己（spam-protection 和 script/save）；邮件修改则不会，因此该处的停滞表现为 "done spam-protection" 之后便没有下文。任何耗时十秒或更久的阶段都会在应用程序级别记录，即使没有开启调试日志。

data.name: Biased upwards on purpose: refusing early costs delivery latency and nothing else, because the refusal is temporary and a sending server retries for days, while a volume that reaches zero costs a database that will not open and a service that will not start.
data.value: 有意偏高：提前拒绝只会付出投递延迟的代价，别无其他，因为拒绝是临时性的，发送服务器会重试数天；而卷空间降到零的代价则是数据库打不开、服务无法启动。

data.name: Both overrides read the score this server recorded in the message, so they need "Add reason to header" switched on (Anti-spam settings). With it off no score is recorded, nothing is provable, and neither override acts - the account keeps the server-wide behaviour. The value in the file is not trusted in that case because nothing stops a SENDER putting one there.
data.value: 这两个覆盖项读取的都是本服务器记录在邮件中的分数，因此它们需要打开“把原因添加到标头”（“反垃圾邮件设置”）。关闭它就不会记录任何分数，什么也无法证明，两个覆盖项都不会起作用 - 该账户保持服务器范围的行为。在这种情况下不信任文件中的值，因为没有什么能阻止发件人自己往里面放一个。

data.name: Both thresholds are 0, so no score can mark or refuse anything - the server tests them with "greater than 0" before using them. It also stops testing as soon as the running total reaches the higher threshold, which is 0, so exactly one check runs in each phase and its result is discarded.
data.value: 两个阈值都是 0，因此没有任何分数能标记或拒绝任何邮件 - 服务器在使用它们之前会先测试“大于 0”。它还会在累计总分达到较高阈值（即 0）时立即停止测试，因此每个阶段恰好只运行一项检查，而且其结果会被丢弃。

data.name: Ceilings on a single IMAP SEARCH or SORT, measured from the start of the search, so that one client searching a very large mailbox cannot occupy a connection indefinitely. If users with big mailboxes report searches failing or returning nothing, these are the two to raise. Either half can be turned off on its own by setting it to 0. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 单次 IMAP SEARCH 或 SORT 的上限，从搜索开始时计算，以免一个客户端搜索超大邮箱时无限期占用一个连接。如果拥有大邮箱的用户报告搜索失败或没有返回结果，就应该调高这两个值。任何一半都可以单独设为 0 以关闭。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Ceilings on what one authenticated account may submit over a rolling period - the brake on a compromised account being used to spam. Counted per account at SMTP submission: messages and envelope recipients separately, and a message refused by the limit gets a temporary error so a real client retries later. Unlike the rest of this page these live in the [SendingLimits] and [SendingLimitsOverrides] sections of hMailServer.INI and are re-read within a couple of seconds of the file changing - saving here applies them WITHOUT a service restart. Counters survive a restart via a state file in the data directory.
data.value: 一个已验证账户在一段滚动时间内可提交量的上限 - 是防止被盗账户被用来发垃圾邮件的刹车。在 SMTP 提交时按账户计数：邮件数和信封收件人数分别计数，被该限制拒绝的邮件会收到临时错误，因此真正的客户端稍后会重试。与本页的其他内容不同，这些设置位于 hMailServer.INI 的 [SendingLimits] 和 [SendingLimitsOverrides] 节，并在文件更改后的几秒钟内重新读取 - 在此处保存后无需重启服务即可生效。计数器通过数据目录中的一个状态文件在重启后得以保留。

data.name: Changes what happens at the delete threshold. Off, a message over it is refused during the SMTP conversation with a 550 and the sender is told. On, it is accepted with a 250 and held for review instead - the sender believes it was delivered and will not retry, which is what makes a false positive recoverable without bouncing to a return path that is probably forged, and also means the review queue becomes the only place that message exists. Applies to checks that run after the message body has been received; a verdict reached before that (a blacklisted connecting IP, a bad HELO) has no message to hold and stays a refusal. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 更改在删除阈值处发生的事情。关闭时，超过该阈值的邮件会在 SMTP 会话期间以 550 拒绝，并告知发件方。打开时，它会以 250 接受并转为暂挂等待审核 - 发件方以为已投递而不会重试，正因如此，误判才能在不退信到一个很可能伪造的返回路径的情况下得以挽回，但这也意味着审核队列成为该邮件唯一存在的地方。适用于在邮件正文接收完毕之后运行的检查；在此之前得出的判定（连接 IP 被列入黑名单、HELO 不正确）没有邮件可暂挂，仍然是拒绝。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Counted logon failures cleared. Addresses already banned stay banned until their "Auto-ban:" range expires - delete it on the IP ranges page to release one now.
data.value: 已清除计数的登录失败。已被封禁的地址在其“Auto-ban:”范围过期之前仍保持封禁 - 要立即解除某一个，请在“IP 范围”页删除它。

data.name: Counted per account from the last login that was allowed, so a refused attempt does not push the next one further away. It is advertised only while it is set, because announcing a limit that is not enforced is worse than announcing nothing.
data.value: 按账户从上一次被允许的登录起计数，因此被拒绝的尝试不会把下一次推得更远。只在设置了该值时才会通告，因为宣布一个并不强制执行的限制比什么都不宣布更糟。

data.name: Counted per connecting IP address across every protocol that authenticates - SMTP AUTH, POP3, IMAP, ManageSieve and the REST API all feed the same counter. On reaching the limit the server clears that address's counted failures and creates an IP range named "Auto-ban: <user>" at priority 100 covering that one address, which expires on its own.
data.value: 按连接的 IP 地址计数，覆盖所有进行身份验证的协议 - SMTP AUTH、POP3、IMAP、ManageSieve 和 REST API 全都汇入同一个计数器。达到限制时，服务器会清除该地址已计数的失败，并创建一个名为“Auto-ban: <user>”、优先级为 100、仅覆盖该地址的 IP 范围，它会自行过期。

data.name: Counted per user name rather than per address, across every protocol that authenticates, so a botnet spreading its guesses over thousands of addresses still locks the mailbox it is guessing at. A locked name is refused with the ordinary invalid-credentials reply and cannot be unlocked by typing the right password - the lock is checked first - so the ceiling is worth setting with the cost in mind. Failures against a name that does not exist lock that name too, deliberately: doing otherwise would let an attacker use the lockout to discover which accounts are real.
data.value: 按用户名而不是按地址计数，覆盖所有进行身份验证的协议，因此把猜测分散到数千个地址上的僵尸网络仍然会锁住它所猜测的那个邮箱。被锁定的用户名会以普通的凭据无效应答拒绝，而且无法通过输入正确密码来解锁 - 锁定会先被检查 - 因此设置此上限时值得权衡代价。针对不存在的用户名的失败同样会锁定该用户名，这是有意的：否则攻击者就能利用锁定来发现哪些账户是真实存在的。

data.name: Crash-durability barrier and an optional integrity scan for the on-disk message store. The defaults preserve the previous behaviour; enabling fsync adds a small per-message cost.
data.value: 磁盘邮件存储的崩溃持久性屏障和可选的完整性扫描。默认值保持以前的行为；启用 fsync 会为每封邮件增加少量开销。

data.name: Each IMAP folder keeps a counter for the next message UID it will issue. If that counter falls behind the messages already in the folder - which a restored or hand-edited database can do - the folder issues a UID it has already used, and a client that caches by UID shows one message where another should be. This moves every counter up to the highest UID its folder actually holds. It never moves one down, so it cannot cause the fault it repairs.
data.value: 每个 IMAP 文件夹都保存一个计数器，记录它将要签发的下一个邮件 UID。如果该计数器落后于文件夹中已有的邮件 - 还原过或手工编辑过的数据库可能造成这种情况 - 文件夹就会签发一个已经用过的 UID，而按 UID 缓存的客户端会在本该显示某封邮件的位置显示另一封。此操作会把每个计数器上调到其文件夹实际持有的最高 UID。它永远不会把计数器下调，因此不可能造成它所修复的这种故障。

data.name: Each accepted inbound message gets one Authentication-Results header (RFC 8601) carrying the SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts this server reached about it. Only checks that actually ran are reported - which checks run is configured on the Anti-spam page - and a message on which no check ran gets no header. An arriving message that already carries an Authentication-Results header claiming this server's own identity has that header removed first, so a sender cannot have a verdict written in this server's name believed downstream (RFC 8601 section 5).
data.value: 每一封被接受的入站邮件都会获得一个 Authentication-Results 标头（RFC 8601），其中带有本服务器对它得出的 SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC 判定。只报告实际运行过的检查 - 运行哪些检查在“反垃圾邮件”页配置 - 而没有运行任何检查的邮件不会获得该标头。到达的邮件如果已经带有声称是本服务器身份的 Authentication-Results 标头，会先被移除该标头，这样发件人就无法以本服务器的名义写入一个让下游相信的判定（RFC 8601 第 5 节）。

data.name: Each cached session costs server memory, and a client that churns handshakes grows the cache - this cap is the defence. A positive value replaces OpenSSL's default cap of 20480 sessions. -1 turns the server-side cache off entirely, which stops session-ID resumption but leaves tickets - which cost the server no memory - unaffected. 0 leaves OpenSSL alone.
data.value: 每个缓存的会话都要占用服务器内存，而频繁重复握手的客户端会让缓存增长 - 此上限就是防线。正值会替换 OpenSSL 默认的 20480 个会话的上限。-1 会完全关闭服务器端缓存，这会停止会话 ID 恢复，但票证（不占用服务器内存）不受影响。0 则不干预 OpenSSL。

data.name: Each check can be enabled separately and given its own score.
data.value: 每项检查都可以单独启用，并赋予各自的分数。

data.name: Each message is scanned twice over: once as the whole file on disk, and then once per attachment, each written out to the temporary folder and handed to the scanner on its own. The second pass is what catches an attachment inside a structure the scanner does not decode for itself. If the message cannot be parsed as MIME the per-attachment pass is skipped and an error is logged.
data.value: 每封邮件会被扫描两遍：先把磁盘上的整个文件扫描一次，然后按附件逐个扫描，每个附件都写出到临时文件夹并单独交给扫描器。第二遍能抓住扫描器自己不解码的结构中所包含的附件。如果邮件无法解析为 MIME，则跳过逐附件扫描并记录一条错误。

data.name: Every counter the metrics endpoint exposes is server-wide, which is what stops metrics becoming reporting: you can see how much mail the server handled, never how much any one domain did. This adds a count of messages sent and received per hosted domain. Off by default, and that is a cardinality decision rather than a cautious one - every label value is a separate time series in whatever scrapes this, so an operator hosting several thousand domains should choose to pay for that rather than find out. Only domains this server hosts are ever labelled, so no amount of mail from strangers can create series. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 指标端点公开的每一个计数器都是服务器范围的，这正是防止指标变成报告的原因：您能看到服务器处理了多少邮件，却永远看不到任何一个域处理了多少。此项会为每个托管域添加已发送和已接收邮件的计数。默认关闭，这是出于基数考虑而不是出于谨慎 - 在抓取它的任何系统中，每个标签值都是一个单独的时间序列，因此托管数千个域的运维人员应当主动选择为此付出代价，而不是事后才发现。只会为本服务器托管的域打标签，因此无论陌生人发来多少邮件都无法创建序列。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Every value fails closed. A section whose Scope is anything but the literal "full" is read-only, a key whose expiry is missing or unreadable counts as expired, and a section with no usable digest is ignored entirely. That is what makes the store safe to edit by hand: a typo can only ever narrow a key, never widen one.
data.value: 每个值都是失败即关闭。Scope 不是字面值 "full" 的节为只读，缺少或无法读取到期时间的密钥算作已过期，没有可用摘要的节会被完全忽略。正因如此，手工编辑该存储才是安全的：一个拼写错误只会缩小密钥的权限，永远不会扩大。

data.name: Forwarding a message keeps the original envelope sender, so the next hop checks SPF for a domain that never authorised this server and the message fails. These are the two answers. SRS rewrites the envelope sender into one this server can vouch for and can undo on the way back, so bounces still reach the original sender; BATV tags the envelope sender of outbound mail so a forged bounce - one for a message this server never sent - can be told apart from a real one. Both use a server-wide secret and do nothing at all until one is set. Changes take effect after a service restart.
data.value: 转发邮件会保留原始的信封发件人，因此下一跳会针对一个从未授权本服务器的域检查 SPF，邮件就会失败。这里是两种解决办法。SRS 把信封发件人改写成本服务器能够担保、并能在返回时还原的地址，这样退信仍能到达原始发件人；BATV 给出站邮件的信封发件人加上标记，这样伪造的退信 - 针对本服务器从未发送过的邮件的退信 - 就能与真实退信区分开。两者都使用一个服务器范围的机密，在设置机密之前什么都不做。更改在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Forwarding breaks SPF, because the envelope sender changes, and often breaks DKIM, because the body is modified - so a mailing list or a forwarded mailbox can turn a message that passed DMARC at the sender into one that fails it here. A valid ARC chain (RFC 8617) from a forwarder you trust carries the original result, and this cancels exactly the DMARC failure score, never more. It needs 'Evaluate DMARC policies' above to be on, since it only ever offsets a penalty that test adds.
data.value: 转发会破坏 SPF，因为信封发件人变了；也常常破坏 DKIM，因为正文被修改了 - 因此邮件列表或转发邮箱可能把一封在发件方通过了 DMARC 的邮件变成在此处失败的邮件。来自您信任的转发方的有效 ARC 链（RFC 8617）会携带原始结果，此项恰好抵消 DMARC 失败分数，不会多抵消。它需要打开上面的“评估 DMARC 策略”，因为它只会抵消该测试所加的处罚。

data.name: Holds the refusal of a wrong password for a while before sending it: the first failure on a connection waits this many seconds, the second twice as long, and so on up to 30 seconds, on SMTP, POP3 and IMAP alike. A correct password is never delayed. The wait is a timer on the connection, not a thread asleep, so a flood of failed logons costs the server nothing but the sockets they arrive on - the reason the old TarpitDelay was a stub for a decade is that the naive version is a self-inflicted outage.
data.value: 在发送错误密码的拒绝应答之前先等待一段时间：连接上的第一次失败等待这么多秒，第二次等待两倍时间，依此类推，最多 30 秒，SMTP、POP3 和 IMAP 一视同仁。正确的密码永远不会被延迟。这个等待是连接上的定时器，而不是休眠的线程，因此大量失败登录除了它们所到达的套接字之外不会给服务器带来任何开销 - 旧的 TarpitDelay 之所以十年来一直是个空壳，就是因为朴素的实现会造成自我引发的停机。

"Server" is hMailServer accepting a connection from a mail client or another mail server; "client" is hMailServer connecting out to deliver mail or to fetch it from an external POP3 account. The effective timeout moves between the minimum and the maximum with server load, so a busy server drops idle connections sooner. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 连接在被关闭之前可以空闲多久，按协议划分，以秒计。“服务器”指 hMailServer 接受来自邮件客户端或另一台邮件服务器的连接；“客户端”指 hMailServer 向外连接以投递邮件或从外部 POP3 账户收取邮件。实际超时会随服务器负载在最小值和最大值之间变动，因此繁忙的服务器会更早断开空闲连接。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: How the server decides that mail.example.com and example.com belong to the same organization, which is what DMARC's default relaxed alignment compares. The old answer was the Public Suffix List - a file of every registry's delegation rules, compiled in and refreshed at build time. DMARCbis replaced it with a walk up the DNS asking each level whether it is an organizational boundary, so a domain owner can state where their boundary is instead of petitioning a list. Turning this off falls back to the compiled list, which is also what happens for any single lookup the walk cannot complete because DNS was unavailable - a resolver outage must not quietly turn relaxed alignment into strict. Costs up to eight DNS queries per domain, cached for five minutes. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 服务器如何判定 mail.example.com 和 example.com 属于同一个组织，这正是 DMARC 默认的宽松对齐所比较的内容。旧的答案是公共后缀列表 - 一个包含每个注册机构委派规则的文件，编译进程序并在构建时刷新。DMARCbis 用沿 DNS 向上遍历、逐级询问是否为组织边界的方式取代了它，这样域所有者可以自行声明边界在哪里，而不必向列表申请。关闭此项会回退到编译进来的列表；对于因 DNS 不可用而无法完成遍历的任何单次查询也是如此 - 解析器故障绝不能悄悄把宽松对齐变成严格对齐。每个域最多花费八次 DNS 查询，缓存五分钟。在重启服务后生效。

Protecting those is the file's own permissions: hMailServer.INI should be readable only by Administrators and by the account the service runs as.

A filter that matches more than one entry authenticates nobody, by design.

data.name: Live, from the running server. The hit rate is the share of lookups answered from memory since the counters last reset - which they do when the service restarts, when a cache is switched off, and when its TTL is changed, so a rate right after any of those describes a very short sample. A lookup for something that does not exist counts as a miss and caches nothing, so a server being probed for addresses it does not host shows a low rate without anything being wrong with the cache.
data.value: 来自正在运行的服务器的实时数据。命中率是自计数器上次重置以来从内存中应答的查询所占的比例 - 计数器会在服务重启、缓存被关闭以及其 TTL 被更改时重置，因此紧接在这些操作之后的比率只反映很短的样本。查询不存在的内容算作未命中且不缓存任何东西，因此被探测其不托管的地址的服务器会显示较低的比率，而缓存本身并没有任何问题。

data.name: Look for "Task SMTP-accept session=42 ip=... waited 8 seconds for a thread in work queue Asynchronous task queue" and, when it is severe, "All 15 threads in work queue Asynchronous task queue have been busy for at least 120 seconds, so no further task on this queue can start". That means every worker is occupied and messages are queuing behind them: one slow dependency does this to the whole server, which is why a single wedged scanner used to look like the server had stopped responding. The task names say which sessions are stuck; the stage timings say what they are stuck on.
data.value: 查找 "Task SMTP-accept session=42 ip=... waited 8 seconds for a thread in work queue Asynchronous task queue"，情况严重时则查找 "All 15 threads in work queue Asynchronous task queue have been busy for at least 120 seconds, so no further task on this queue can start"。这表示所有工作线程都被占用，邮件在它们后面排队：一个缓慢的依赖项就会让整个服务器如此，这就是为什么过去一个卡住的扫描器看起来像是服务器停止响应了。任务名称说明哪些会话卡住了；阶段耗时说明它们卡在什么上面。

data.name: Moving a message into the folder designated Junk reports it to sa-learn as spam, and moving one back out reports it as ham, so the filter learns from what people already do rather than from a separate ritual nobody performs. Off by default: it runs sa-learn per move, and a user who files newsletters in Junk is teaching the filter that newsletters are spam for everyone the scanner serves. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 把邮件移入指定为 Junk 的文件夹，会向 sa-learn 报告它是垃圾邮件；把邮件再移出来，则报告它是正常邮件。这样过滤器就能从人们本来就在做的事情中学习，而不是从一套没人会执行的单独仪式中学习。默认关闭：它每移动一次就运行一次 sa-learn，而一个把新闻邮件归入 Junk 的用户，是在教过滤器：对该扫描器所服务的所有人来说，新闻邮件都是垃圾邮件。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: NCSA Common Log Format writes one line per entry as host, ident, session, [date], "category and message", status, bytes - so a log analyser can count 5xx replies without knowing anything about hMailServer. Ident and bytes are always "-" (the server never queries identd and the logger is not told transfer sizes), and the AWStats journal is a separate file that this setting does not change: its own switch is above.
data.value: NCSA 通用日志格式每个条目写一行，格式为 host、ident、session、[date]、"category and message"、status、bytes - 这样日志分析器无需了解 hMailServer 的任何知识就能统计 5xx 应答。ident 和 bytes 始终为 "-"（服务器从不查询 identd，日志记录器也不知道传输大小），而 AWStats 日志是一个独立的文件，此设置不会改变它：它自己的开关在上面。

data.name: Off by default, and inert when off: directory-linked accounts are then validated the old way, through Windows logon. When on, the same accounts - the ones with the Directory tab filled in - are validated by an LDAP bind against the server below instead. Non-directory accounts are never affected either way.

data.name: Off by default, and this is the decision worth thinking about. Off, an engine that stops answering lets spam through until somebody notices. On, it stops the mail instead - and a message deferred while nobody is watching is a message that eventually bounces. Off is the recoverable failure, which is why it is the default.
data.value: 默认关闭，而这是值得考虑的决定。关闭时，停止应答的引擎会放垃圾邮件通过，直到有人注意到。打开时，它会改为拦下邮件 - 而在无人看管时被推迟的邮件最终会被退回。关闭是可以挽回的失败，这就是它作为默认值的原因。

data.name: Off by default. An account that stops being visible in the directory is far more often a search that changed than a person who left, and the two mistakes do not cost the same. Nothing is disabled at all when the enumeration was cut short or came back empty.
data.value: 默认关闭。在目录中不再可见的账户，更常见的原因是搜索条件变了，而不是有人离职了，而这两种错误的代价并不相同。当枚举被中途截断或返回为空时，完全不会禁用任何账户。

data.name: Off by default. An account that stops being visible is far more often a filter that changed than a person who left, and the two mistakes do not cost the same. No message is ever deleted and no account is removed - re-enabling one restores everything.
data.value: 默认关闭。不再可见的账户，更常见的原因是过滤器变了，而不是有人离职了，而这两种错误的代价并不相同。永远不会删除任何邮件，也不会移除任何账户 - 重新启用一个账户即可恢复一切。

data.name: Off by default. Turning it on means the server starts storing mail it considers spam, so watch the retention window below.
data.value: 默认关闭。打开它意味着服务器开始存储它认为是垃圾邮件的邮件，因此请留意下面的保留窗口。

data.name: Off by default. When off, an unreachable directory refuses the logon and the server reports the real reason (throttled to once per minute per distinct problem) instead of retrying through Windows logon - which cannot succeed on a host that is not domain-joined, and whose failure would bury a precise diagnostic under an indistinguishable one. Turn on only on a domain-joined host that wants LDAP as its first choice. A password the directory REJECTED never falls back either way: retrying it would double every failed attempt and let one wrong password trigger a directory lockout policy.
data.value: 默认关闭。关闭时，无法访问的目录会拒绝登录，服务器报告真实原因（每个不同的问题每分钟最多一次），而不是通过 Windows 登录重试 - 那在未加入域的主机上不可能成功，而且其失败会把精确的诊断埋没在无法区分的诊断之下。只在希望把 LDAP 作为首选的已加入域的主机上打开。被目录拒绝的密码无论如何都不会回退：重试它会让每次失败尝试翻倍，并让一个错误密码触发目录锁定策略。

data.name: Off by default. With unprotected LDAP and a simple bind, the server does NOT send the password and does NOT guess what you meant: it refuses the logon and reports the contradiction, once per minute. Turning this on sends passwords in the clear and should only ever happen on a network you control end to end.
data.value: 默认关闭。在未受保护的 LDAP 配合简单绑定时，服务器不会发送密码，也不会猜测您的本意：它会拒绝登录并每分钟报告一次这一矛盾。打开此项会以明文发送密码，只应在您端到端完全掌控的网络上进行。

data.name: Off, and off is what RFC 8301 requires: it removed rsa-sha1 from DKIM outright, so a signer must not use it and a verifier must treat a signature that does as invalid. A DKIM signature is an assertion of identity and DMARC alignment is built on it, and SHA-1 collisions have been practical since 2020 - a signature somebody can forge is worth less than no signature at all, because it carries the signer's domain past an aligned DMARC check. Turning this on restores both halves: signatures using it verify again, and a domain configured to sign with it does so instead of being upgraded to rsa-sha256. Keys shorter than 1024 bits are refused regardless, and this setting does not affect that. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 关闭，而关闭正是 RFC 8301 的要求：它把 rsa-sha1 从 DKIM 中彻底移除，因此签名方不得使用它，验证方必须把使用它的签名视为无效。DKIM 签名是身份声明，DMARC 对齐建立在它之上，而 SHA-1 碰撞自 2020 年起已切实可行 - 一个别人能伪造的签名比没有签名更糟，因为它能让签名方的域通过对齐的 DMARC 检查。打开此项会恢复两个方面：使用它的签名重新可以通过验证，配置为用它签名的域也会照此签名，而不是被升级到 rsa-sha256。短于 1024 位的密钥无论如何都会被拒绝，此设置不影响这一点。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Off. Directory-linked accounts are validated through Windows logon (LogonUser), which only works when this host is joined to the domain - every failure there looks like a wrong password.
data.value: 关闭。关联目录的账户通过 Windows 登录（LogonUser）验证，这只有在本主机加入了域时才有效 - 那里的每一次失败看起来都像密码错误。

data.name: Off. No message is deferred on a first attempt.
data.value: 关闭。首次尝试时不会推迟任何邮件。

data.name: On
data.value: 打开

data.name: On by default, and only an explicit 0 in the INI turns it off. Turned off, the encrypted connection no longer proves it reaches YOUR directory: anyone who can intercept it can present any certificate and collect every password sent over it. The server notes the disabling in its application log once per service start. Only meaningful for LDAPS and StartTLS.
data.value: 默认打开，只有 INI 中明确的 0 才会关闭它。关闭后，加密连接不再能证明它到达的是您的目录：任何能截获它的人都可以出示任意证书并收集经由它发送的每一个密码。服务器每次服务启动时会在应用程序日志中记录一次此项已禁用。仅对 LDAPS 和 StartTLS 有意义。

data.name: On by default, and the one switch here whose default is not the cautious one. With it off, a message for a mailbox that is already over quota is accepted and then answered with a non-delivery report addressed to the envelope sender - which the traffic that fills mailboxes fastest has forged. That report then goes from this server to somebody who sent nothing, which is backscatter, and it is this server's reputation that pays for it. Refusing at RCPT TO with a temporary 452 instead leaves the message in the sending server's queue, so a legitimate sender's mail waits for the mailbox to be emptied and is eventually reported by the machine that knows who the sender really is. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 默认打开，是这里唯一一个默认值不是保守选项的开关。关闭它时，发给已超出配额的邮箱的邮件会先被接受，然后以一份寄给信封发件人的未送达报告作答 - 而最快填满邮箱的那类流量恰恰伪造了信封发件人。这份报告随后从本服务器发给一个什么都没发过的人，这就是反向散射，付出代价的是本服务器的声誉。改为在 RCPT TO 时以临时的 452 拒绝，则邮件留在发送服务器的队列中，合法发件人的邮件会等到邮箱被清空，并最终由知道发件人究竟是谁的那台机器来报告。在重启服务后生效。

It is what the dashboard's 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days views and GET /api/v1/metrics/history read. A week of minute-resolution history is about a hundred and forty thousand small rows. 0 turns the sampler off. Applies after a service restart.

data.name: POP3 has no way for the server to tell a client that mail has arrived, so clients that want to look responsive poll - and some poll every few seconds. Each poll is a new connection, a TLS handshake and a password verification, which with Argon2id is deliberately expensive, so a handful of eager clients can cost more than the mail does. Setting a delay tells clients the interval in the server's capability list and refuses logins that arrive early with a code the client understands as "slow down" rather than as a wrong password. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: POP3 没有办法让服务器告诉客户端邮件已到达，因此想要显得灵敏的客户端会轮询 - 有些每隔几秒就轮询一次。每次轮询都是一个新连接、一次 TLS 握手和一次密码验证，而用 Argon2id 时密码验证是有意昂贵的，因此少数几个急切的客户端的开销可能比邮件本身还大。设置延迟会在服务器的能力列表中告知客户端间隔，并用客户端理解为“慢一点”而不是“密码错误”的代码拒绝过早到达的登录。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Put a load balancer, a TLS terminator or a Postfix relay in front of the SMTP listener and every connection appears to come from IT - which silently breaks DNSBL checks, SPF, greylisting, auto-ban and the IP range rules all at once, while everything still reports success. These let a named upstream pass on the real client address. Both are off by default and trust nobody until an address is listed, because a peer that can rewrite its own source address has defeated every IP-based control on this server. The upstream has to be configured to send it or nothing here changes: HAProxy needs send-proxy or send-proxy-v2 on its server line, and a Postfix relay needs XCLIENT enabled towards this host. hMailServer cannot check that from here - and note that once an address is listed as a PROXY protocol proxy the header becomes REQUIRED from it, so a proxy that does not send one will have its connections dropped.
data.value: 在 SMTP 监听器前面放一个负载均衡器、TLS 终结器或 Postfix 中继，那么每个连接看起来都来自它 - 这会悄悄地同时破坏 DNSBL 检查、SPF、灰名单、自动封禁和 IP 范围规则，而一切仍然报告成功。这些设置让指定的上游传递真实的客户端地址。两者默认都关闭，并且在列出地址之前不信任任何人，因为能改写自己源地址的对端已经击败了本服务器上所有基于 IP 的控制。上游必须配置为发送它，否则此处什么都不会改变：HAProxy 需要在其 server 行上加 send-proxy 或 send-proxy-v2，Postfix 中继需要对本主机启用 XCLIENT。hMailServer 无法从此处检查这一点 - 并且请注意，一旦某个地址被列为 PROXY 协议代理，就会要求它必须发送该标头，因此不发送标头的代理的连接会被丢弃。

data.name: READ THIS FIRST: IMAP, POP3 and SMTP have no way to change a password, and the self-service portal refuses an expired one at sign-in like every other surface. An expired password is therefore renewed by an administrator - or by the person themselves only if they hold an app password, which still signs them in to the portal, where the expired password is accepted as the current one when setting a new one. Turning this on means someone has to be available for everybody else. Existing app passwords keep working, which is also the one way an affected person can still collect mail; Active Directory accounts are exempt, because their password lives in the directory and expires by its policy, not this one. The clock started when this server was upgraded, so nobody is expired the moment you set this.
data.value: 请先阅读：IMAP、POP3 和 SMTP 都没有更改密码的途径，而自助服务门户与其他所有入口一样，会在登录时拒绝已过期的密码。因此，过期的密码由管理员来更新 - 或者由本人更新，但前提是本人持有应用密码：应用密码仍能登录门户，在那里设置新密码时，过期的密码会被当作当前密码接受。打开此项意味着必须有人随时能为其他所有人做这件事。现有的应用密码继续有效，这也是受影响的人仍能收取邮件的唯一途径；Active Directory 账户不受此限，因为它们的密码在目录中，按目录的策略过期，而不是按这个。计时从本服务器升级时开始，因此在您设置此项的那一刻不会有任何人过期。

data.name: RFC 7208 4.6.4. A "void lookup" is a term of a sender's SPF policy - an a:, mx: or exists: - whose DNS query comes back with nothing at all. The separate limit of ten DNS-querying terms bounds what a policy can ask this server to look up; it does not bound what a policy can waste, and ten terms naming hosts that do not exist cost a full resolution each for a record that can never match. Two is what the RFC says. It also catches the ordinary case: a policy still listing hosts decommissioned years ago, which its owner would rather be told about. Raising it is safe; 0 switches the limit off, which is the setting for a correspondent whose policy is wrong in exactly this way and whose mail you would rather take. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: RFC 7208 第 4.6.4 节。“空查询”指的是发件人 SPF 策略中的某一项 - a:、mx: 或 exists: - 其 DNS 查询完全没有返回任何结果。另一条“最多十个发起 DNS 查询的项”的限制约束的是一份策略可以要求本服务器查询多少次；它并不约束一份策略能浪费多少，而十个指向并不存在的主机的项，每一个都要为一条永远不可能匹配的记录付出一次完整的解析。RFC 给出的数值是二。它同时也能发现一种寻常情形：一份策略仍然列着多年前就已下线的主机，而它的所有者多半也希望有人告诉他这件事。调高这个值是安全的；0 表示关闭该限制，这正是为那种策略恰好错在此处、而您又宁愿收下其邮件的通信方准备的设置。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Receivers look up the PTR record of the connecting IP address and compare it with the name the server announces in HELO/EHLO; this server judges incoming mail by the same standard when the PTR and HELO checks on Anti-spam settings are on. Unlike every other record on this page, the PTR is NOT published in your domain's zone: it lives in the reverse zone of the IP address, which belongs to whoever owns the address - usually your hosting provider or ISP. Ask them to set it; there is nothing to paste into your own DNS console.

data.name: Records the SPF verdict for each accepted inbound message as a Received-SPF header (RFC 7208 section 9.1). The header is only written when the SPF check actually ran, so 'Check SPF' must be enabled on the Anti-spam page for it to appear.
data.value: 把每封被接受的入站邮件的 SPF 判定结果记录为一个 Received-SPF 标头（RFC 7208 第 9.1 节）。只有在 SPF 检查确实运行过时才会写入该标头，因此必须在“反垃圾邮件”页上启用“检查 SPF”，它才会出现。

data.name: Records the verdicts this server itself reached about each inbound message - SPF, DKIM and DMARC - as trace headers on the delivered message, for downstream filters and diagnostics (RFC 8601, RFC 7208).
data.value: 把本服务器自己对每封入站邮件作出的判定 - SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC - 作为跟踪标头写在投递的邮件上，供下游过滤器和诊断使用（RFC 8601、RFC 7208）。

data.name: Required. With this empty the setting above does nothing at all, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight: anyone can fabricate a whole ARC chain and seal it with a key they publish in their own DNS, and it will validate perfectly, so a passing chain proves nothing unless you already trust the sealer. This list is not an option of the feature - it is the feature. Name the exact domains whose seals you honour (the d= of their ARC-Seal), separated by commas, semicolons or spaces; matching is exact, so a suffix of a trusted name is not trusted.
data.value: 必填。此项留空时，上面的设置将完全不起作用，而这是有意为之，不是疏漏：任何人都可以伪造一整条 ARC 链，并用自己在其 DNS 中发布的密钥为它加封，而它会完美通过验证，因此除非您本来就信任加封方，否则一条通过验证的链什么都证明不了。这份列表不是该功能的一个选项 - 它就是该功能本身。请写明您认可其封印的确切域（即其 ARC-Seal 的 d=），以逗号、分号或空格分隔；匹配是精确匹配，因此受信任名称的某个后缀并不会被信任。

data.name: Runs the same steps the server runs, in the same order, using the values in the editors above as they stand: connect, protect the transport, bind the service credential, search for the user - and, only if a password is typed below, bind as that user to prove it. The password is used once and never stored, and the test refuses to run any configuration that would put a password on the network unprotected. One honest caveat: the test runs from this computer, so a firewall that treats this machine and the hMailServer service differently can make the two disagree.
data.value: 按服务器所用的相同顺序执行相同的步骤，并直接使用上面各编辑框中当前的值：连接、保护传输、绑定服务凭据、搜索用户 - 并且只有在下面输入了密码时，才以该用户的身份绑定来加以证实。密码只使用一次，绝不存储，而且只要某项配置会让密码不加保护地经过网络，测试就会拒绝运行。有一点必须坦白说明：测试是从这台计算机上运行的，因此如果防火墙对这台机器和 hMailServer 服务区别对待，两者的结果就可能不一致。

data.name: Sends the daily aggregate reports that domains ask for with a rua= tag in their DMARC record (RFC 7489) - who sent mail claiming to be them, and whether it passed. Reports only go to an address outside the policy domain when that address's own DNS says it wants them, so a domain cannot use its DMARC record to aim this server's reports at somebody else.
data.value: 发送各域通过其 DMARC 记录中的 rua= 标签请求的每日汇总报告 (RFC 7489) - 谁声称是它们在发送邮件，以及是否通过。只有当策略域之外的地址自身的 DNS 表示希望接收时，报告才会发往该地址，因此一个域无法利用其 DMARC 记录把本服务器的报告引向别人。

data.name: Sends the message as counted chunks rather than dot-stuffed DATA. It is also what carries a binary message onward without rewriting it: a message accepted as BINARYMIME can only be relayed as it arrived to a server that offers both this and BINARYMIME. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 把邮件作为计数的分块发送，而不是使用经过点填充的 DATA。它也正是在不重写邮件的情况下把二进制邮件继续送出去的手段：以 BINARYMIME 接受的邮件，只能按其到达时的原样中继给同时提供本项和 BINARYMIME 的服务器。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: Sends the recipient's address as the User: header, so spamd applies that mailbox's own preferences - the shape a virtual-user spamd (--virtual-config-dir with %u or %d) expects. A scan runs once per message, not once per recipient, so a message to several people cannot be scanned under any one of their preferences and uses the profile above instead.
data.value: 将收件人的地址作为 User: 标头发送，这样 spamd 就会应用该邮箱自己的偏好设置 - 这是虚拟用户 spamd (带 %u 或 %d 的 --virtual-config-dir) 所期望的形式。扫描按每封邮件运行一次，而不是按每个收件人一次，因此发给多人的邮件无法按其中任何一人的偏好扫描，而是改用上面的配置文件。

data.name: Slows a session that names more recipients than a legitimate message needs. Past the count, every further RCPT TO in an unauthenticated session waits the delay before it is answered - a dictionary attack or a spam run names hundreds of addresses and pays for each one, while a sending MTA names a handful and never reaches the count. Authenticated sessions and IP ranges with spam protection off are exempt. The wait is a timer on the connection, not a thread asleep. Takes effect at once; stored in hMailServer.ini as SmtpTarpitCount and SmtpTarpitDelaySeconds.
data.value: 减慢指定收件人数量超出正常邮件所需的会话。超过该数量后，未验证会话中的每个后续 RCPT TO 都要等待延迟后才被应答 - 字典攻击或垃圾邮件群发会指定数百个地址并为每一个付出代价，而正常的发送 MTA 只指定寥寥几个，永远达不到该数量。已验证会话和关闭了垃圾邮件防护的 IP 范围不受影响。等待是连接上的计时器，不是休眠的线程。立即生效；以 SmtpTarpitCount 和 SmtpTarpitDelaySeconds 存储在 hMailServer.ini 中。

data.name: TLS 1.3 has its own suite list, its own names and its own setter, so the cipher list above does not restrict it. Colon separated, most preferred first, using the RFC 8446 names (TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256) - not the OpenSSL cipher-list names. Leave empty to keep OpenSSL's defaults; a name this build does not recognise is skipped and reported rather than failing the whole list.

data.name: The authserv-id: the first token of every Authentication-Results header this server writes, always lower-cased, and the name a downstream filter checks before trusting the verdicts. data.name: The counterpart to ARC sealing: on inbound mail, a valid ARC chain from a trusted sealer can offset the DMARC failure score for a message whose DMARC pass was destroyed by forwarding (RFC 8617). It is configured on the Anti-spam page, under sender authentication, because it is stored with the other anti-spam settings rather than in hMailServer.INI. With the trusted-sealer list empty the feature does nothing at all, by design: anyone can fabricate an entire ARC chain and seal it with keys published in their own DNS, and it will validate perfectly, so a passing chain proves nothing unless you already trust the sealer. The list is not an option of the feature - it is the feature. The offset never exceeds the DMARC failure score, and applies only while DMARC scoring is enabled on the Anti-spam page.
data.value: ARC 密封的对应功能: 对于入站邮件，来自受信任密封者的有效 ARC 链可以抵消因转发而破坏了 DMARC 通过结果的邮件的 DMARC 失败分数 (RFC 8617)。它在反垃圾邮件设置页的发件人身份验证下配置，因为它与其他反垃圾邮件设置一起存储，而不是存放在 hMailServer.INI 中。受信任密封者列表为空时，此功能有意什么也不做: 任何人都可以伪造一整条 ARC 链，并用发布在自己 DNS 中的密钥密封它，而它会完美地通过验证，所以除非您已经信任该密封者，否则通过验证的链什么也证明不了。这个列表不是该功能的一个选项 - 它就是该功能本身。抵消量永远不会超过 DMARC 失败分数，并且仅在反垃圾邮件设置页启用了 DMARC 评分时才生效。

data.name: The database: check for errors mentioning the connection pool. When the pool deadline expires a recipient lookup answers 451 4.3.2 rather than 550, so a database locked by a backup defers mail instead of bouncing it.

data.name: The delivery that takes a mailbox past this percentage produces one notice to the person whose mailbox it is, from their own domain's postmaster. ONE, not one per message: the server treats the threshold as something the mailbox CROSSES rather than a state it is in, so a mailbox sitting at 95% is not warned about again on every delivery - which would fill it faster than the mail does. Emptying the mailbox and filling it again warns again, which is the behaviour anyone would expect and is free here rather than something that had to be remembered and expired. On by default, because the alternative is what this server did before: say nothing at all until mail starts being refused, by which point the person it happens to is the last to know. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 使邮箱越过此百分比的那次投递，会以该邮箱所属域的 postmaster 名义向邮箱所有者发出一条通知。只有一条，而不是每封邮件一条: 服务器把阈值当作邮箱“越过”的一条线，而不是它所处的一种状态，因此停留在 95% 的邮箱不会在每次投递时都被再次警告 - 那样填满邮箱的速度会比邮件本身还快。清空邮箱再重新填满会再次警告，这是任何人都会预期的行为，而且在这里无需记录和过期机制就自然实现了。默认开启，因为另一种做法就是本服务器以前的做法: 在邮件开始被拒绝之前什么也不说，而到那时，受影响的人是最后一个知道的。服务重启后生效。

data.name: The groups this server will agree a TLS key with, in OpenSSL's list form. As shipped it offers the two post-quantum hybrids first and falls back to X25519 and the NIST curves for a peer that has neither, so nothing changes for an older client. An empty list, or one OpenSSL rejects or that would leave no group enabled, is not applied: the server logs it and uses the classical fallback, so a mistake here cannot take TLS down - but it does silently give up the hybrids, which is why the shipped list is shown rather than a blank. Change it against a scan rather than in the dark. Applies after a service restart.

data.name: The hMailServer 6.x line is one such effort. The original open-source mail server has been rebuilt on a current toolchain (Visual Studio 2026 / MSVC v145 and .NET 10), re-armed with modern cryptography (PBKDF2 / Argon2id, SCRAM-SHA-256, OAuth2) and the transport-security standards expected of a mail server today (DANE + DNSSEC, MTA-STS, ARC, Ed25519 DKIM, TLS-RPT and ACME / Let's Encrypt). It has been hardened against protocol and denial-of-service defects, given Sieve / ManageSieve filtering, health and OpenTelemetry observability, broad MySQL / MariaDB / MS SQL / PostgreSQL support, and this modern Fluent-design Control Panel in place of the legacy administrator.
data.value: hMailServer 6.x 系列就是这样一项努力。这个原始的开源邮件服务器已在当前工具链 (Visual Studio 2026 / MSVC v145 和 .NET 10) 上重建，重新配备了现代密码学 (PBKDF2 / Argon2id、SCRAM-SHA-256、OAuth2) 以及当今邮件服务器所应具备的传输安全标准 (DANE + DNSSEC、MTA-STS、ARC、Ed25519 DKIM、TLS-RPT 和 ACME / Let's Encrypt)。它针对协议和拒绝服务缺陷进行了加固，加入了 Sieve / ManageSieve 过滤、健康检查和 OpenTelemetry 可观测性、对 MySQL / MariaDB / MS SQL / PostgreSQL 的广泛支持，以及这个取代旧版管理器的 Fluent 设计的现代控制面板。

data.name: The server's Host name (Delivery of e-mail) is EMPTY, so it announces its Windows computer name in HELO/EHLO - not a public DNS name - and no "a:" mechanism can honestly be offered. data.name: The single value AEAD-ONLY (case-insensitive) is a named preset rather than an OpenSSL cipher string: forward-secret AEAD suites only (ECDHE or DHE with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305), excluding every CBC-mode suite - the Lucky13 padding-oracle family - and static-RSA key exchange. The cost: TLS 1.2 clients that only speak CBC suites cannot connect, and TLS 1.0/1.1 are left with no usable cipher at all, so do not enable those protocols alongside it. TLS 1.3 is unaffected - its suites are AEAD by construction and are configured separately below. A misspelled preset name is rejected and reported, not silently ignored.
data.value: 单一值 AEAD-ONLY (不区分大小写) 是一个具名预设而不是 OpenSSL 密码字符串: 只有前向保密的 AEAD 套件 (使用 AES-GCM 或 ChaCha20-Poly1305 的 ECDHE 或 DHE)，排除所有 CBC 模式套件 - Lucky13 填充预言机一族 - 以及静态 RSA 密钥交换。代价是: 只会 CBC 套件的 TLS 1.2 客户端无法连接，而 TLS 1.0/1.1 完全没有可用的密码，因此不要在它旁边启用这些协议。TLS 1.3 不受影响 - 其套件在设计上就是 AEAD，并在下面单独配置。拼错的预设名称会被拒绝并报告，而不是被悄悄忽略。

data.name: These are read by the server from the [LDAP] section of hMailServer.INI, and re-read within two seconds of a save, so no restart is needed. The defaults suit Active Directory; a directory that is not Windows will not have sAMAccountName and needs the attribute names changed.

data.name: These belong together: expiry without history teaches people to alternate between two passwords, which is worse than not expiring at all. History only ever refuses a CHANGE, at the moment somebody is able to pick something else, so nobody is locked out by it. Expiry refuses a LOGON - read its description before turning it on.
data.value: 这两项是配套的: 没有历史记录的过期会教人们在两个密码之间来回切换，这比根本不过期更糟。历史记录只在有人可以选择其他密码的那一刻拒绝一次“更改”，因此不会把任何人锁在外面。过期拒绝的是“登录” - 开启之前请阅读它的说明。

Ask the IP's owner to make the PTR of your public IP resolve to exactly this name, and publish an A record for this name pointing back at the same IP - receivers check both directions.
data.value: 这是“设置”>“电子邮件投递”>“主机名”，即服务器在每次出站投递的 HELO/EHLO 中通告的名称 (Utilities::ComputerName)。请让 IP 的所有者把您公网 IP 的 PTR 精确解析到此名称，并为此名称发布一条指回同一 IP 的 A 记录 - 接收方会检查两个方向。

The server only hands it back over the COM API - it does not translate anything itself, and this Control Panel has a language setting of its own (the globe button in the sidebar) - so it affects third-party administration tools only. Bounce and error wording is on the Server messages page.
data.value: 这是 hMailServer.INI 中的 [Settings] UseLanguage。服务器只是通过 COM API 把它返回 - 它自己不翻译任何内容，而此控制面板有自己的语言设置 (侧边栏中的地球图标按钮) - 因此它只影响第三方管理工具。退信和错误的措辞在“服务器消息”页。

data.name: This is the latest release
data.value: 这是最新版本

data.name: This is the only time it will ever be shown. The store keeps a SHA-256 digest, not the key, so it cannot be recovered or re-displayed - if it is lost, revoke it here and create another.
data.value: 这是它唯一一次显示。存储保存的是 SHA-256 摘要而不是密钥本身，因此无法恢复或再次显示 - 如果丢失，请在此吊销并另建一个。

data.name: This page used to collect every hMailServer.INI value without a home, which meant it was filed by where the value is stored rather than by what it does - and where a value is stored is the one thing you never need to know. Each of these now sits with the rest of its own feature. Nothing was removed and no value changed; only the page it is edited on.
data.value: 本页以前收集所有没有归属的 hMailServer.INI 值，也就是说它们是按值存放在哪里归档的，而不是按它们做什么 - 而值存放在哪里恰恰是您永远不需要知道的事。现在每一项都和它自己的功能放在一起。没有移除任何内容，也没有更改任何值；只有编辑它的页面变了。

data.name: This panel can compare RSA and ECDSA keys; this key parses as neither, so whether it matches the certificate is only proven when the server loads the pair.
data.value: 此面板可以比较 RSA 和 ECDSA 密钥；此密钥两者都解析不了，因此它是否与证书匹配只有在服务器加载这一对时才能证明。

data.name: This range _expires
data.value: 此范围会过期(_E)

data.name: This runs before virus scanning and independently of it: it applies even with every scanner switched off, and it applies to messages the size limit above would skip. A matched attachment is replaced by a short text file explaining the removal rather than being deleted outright, so the recipient can tell something was taken out.
data.value: 这在病毒扫描之前独立运行: 即使所有扫描器都关闭它也生效，并且对上面大小限制会跳过的邮件也生效。匹配的附件会被替换为一个说明移除原因的短文本文件，而不是直接删除，这样收件人能知道有东西被取走了。

data.name: This runs while the sending server waits for its answer to DATA, so the number is a promise about the worst case rather than a hint. It bounds the connection as well as the reply: an engine whose machine has gone away would otherwise cost the operating system's own TCP timeout on every message.
data.value: 这在发送方服务器等待其 DATA 应答时运行，因此这个数字是对最坏情况的承诺，而不是提示。它既限制连接也限制应答: 否则一台机器已经消失的引擎会在每封邮件上耗掉操作系统自身的 TCP 超时。

data.name: This server only CHECKS SPF on incoming mail; publishing the record is for everyone else - it tells receiving servers which machines are allowed to send mail claiming to be from
data.value: 本服务器只对入站邮件检查 SPF；发布记录是给其他所有人看的 - 它告诉接收服务器哪些机器被允许发送声称来自以下域的邮件:

data.name: This server requires a one-time code for the administrator.
data.value: 本服务器要求管理员提供一次性验证码。

data.name: This setting lives on each IP range rather than with the rest of TLS, which is the main reason it goes unnoticed. It is the only control that refuses a plaintext password regardless of what the port allows, so it is what makes an optional-STARTTLS port safe for clients.
data.value: 此设置位于每个 IP 范围上而不是与其他 TLS 设置放在一起，这是它被忽视的主要原因。它是唯一一个无论端口允许什么都会拒绝明文密码的控制项，因此正是它让可选 STARTTLS 的端口对客户端来说是安全的。

data.name: This suggestion cannot know your other senders. If anything else sends mail as {0} - a newsletter service, a website contact form, a hosted mailbox provider - copying this record as-is makes that mail fail SPF at every receiver that checks it. Add those senders to the record first.
data.value: 此建议无法知道您的其他发件方。如果还有其他东西以 {0} 的名义发送邮件 - 邮件简报服务、网站联系表单、托管邮箱提供商 - 原样复制此记录会让那些邮件在每个检查 SPF 的接收方处失败。请先把那些发件方加入记录。

data.name: This validates against a LOCAL Windows account on the server's own computer, not against a domain. That is the right setting when there is no Active Directory.
data.value: 这会对服务器自身计算机上的本地 Windows 账户进行验证，而不是对域。在没有 Active Directory 时这是正确的设置。

data.name: This validates against the domain "{0}". The server's own computer must be joined to it.

data.name: Three things have to be true of that account before the service will start under it, and none of them can be done from here. It needs the "Log on as a service" right (secpol.msc > Local Policies > User Rights Assignment, or your domain policy). It needs full control of the data folder, the log folder and - for the built-in database - the database folder, plus read access to the program folder AND write access to hMailServer.INI inside it, because the service writes its own settings there; if that file is read-only to the account, saved settings are lost at the next restart with no error. And for an external database it needs whatever that server requires, which for MSSQL with integrated security means a login of its own. A service that cannot log on reports error 1069 in the Windows event log and does not start.
data.value: 该账户必须满足三个条件，服务才能以它启动，而这三个条件都无法在此处完成。它需要“作为服务登录”权限 (secpol.msc > 本地策略 > 用户权限分配，或您的域策略)。它需要对数据文件夹、日志文件夹以及 - 对于内置数据库 - 数据库文件夹的完全控制权，外加对程序文件夹的读取权限和对其中 hMailServer.INI 的写入权限，因为服务会把自己的设置写在那里；如果该文件对此账户是只读的，保存的设置会在下次重启时丢失且没有任何错误。而对于外部数据库，它需要那台服务器所要求的任何东西，对于使用集成安全性的 MSSQL 来说，这意味着一个自己的登录名。无法登录的服务会在 Windows 事件日志中报告错误 1069，并且不会启动。

data.name: Turning this off stops session tickets on every TLS version: TLS 1.2 and older clients fall back to the server-side session cache, which never leaves this process, and TLS 1.3 clients are sent no ticket at all. For an administrator whose policy is that nothing derived from a long-lived key ever goes on the wire. The only cost is resumption efficiency - every client can still connect with a full handshake.
