data.name: What every listener protects, what it presents to prove who it is, and what can still be negotiated. Nothing on this page can be edited — each row opens the page that owns the setting.
data.value: 每个监听器保护什么、出示什么来证明身份，以及还有什么可以协商。本页无法编辑任何内容 — 每一行都会打开拥有该设置的页面。

data.name: What every listener protects, which certificate it presents and when that expires, and what can still be negotiated.
data.value: 每个监听器保护什么、出示哪个证书及其何时到期，以及还有什么可以协商。

data.name: What every spam check is doing right now, in the order the server runs them, and where each is switched on.
data.value: 每项垃圾邮件检查此刻在做什么，按服务器运行它们的顺序排列，以及各自在哪里开启。

data.name: What gets scanned
data.value: 扫描的内容

data.name: What happened to a particular message - searchable by sender or recipient, instead of grepping logs.
data.value: 某一封邮件遭遇了什么 - 可按发件人或收件人搜索，而不必 grep 日志。

data.name: What happened to a particular message. Search by any address - it matches senders and recipients - then follow one row to see every event for that message in order.
data.value: 某一封邮件遭遇了什么。按任意地址搜索 - 它会匹配发件人和收件人 - 然后沿着一行查看该邮件的每个事件的先后顺序。

data.name: What happens to a TCP connection this server refuses before any protocol conversation starts: one from an address no IP range allows, or one over that range's connection limit. Both of those are configured on the IP ranges page. Locking out an address that keeps failing to log on is a different mechanism entirely and is on the Auto-ban page.
data.value: 对于本服务器在任何协议会话开始之前就拒绝的 TCP 连接会发生什么: 来自没有任何 IP 范围允许的地址的连接，或超过该范围连接上限的连接。这两者都在“IP 范围”页配置。把反复登录失败的地址锁定在外是完全不同的机制，位于“自动封禁”页。

data.name: What happens to a message
data.value: 邮件会发生什么

data.name: What happens to an infected message
data.value: 受感染的邮件会发生什么

data.name: What has to exist outside this server
data.value: 本服务器之外必须存在的东西

data.name: What it may do
data.value: 它可以做什么

data.name: What rotation defends: OpenSSL's default ticket key is generated once, when the listener starts, and is never rotated, so every ticket that listener issues for the life of the process is sealed under the same key - and that key, recovered later, decrypts every ticket ever recorded. With an interval set, a captured ticket is useless after at most two intervals. 86400 is a day. Only meaningful while session tickets are enabled above.
data.value: 轮换防范的是什么: OpenSSL 的默认票据密钥在监听器启动时生成一次，之后永不轮换，因此该监听器在进程整个生命周期内签发的每张票据都用同一个密钥密封 - 而这个密钥一旦事后被恢复，就能解密曾经记录下来的每一张票据。设置了间隔后，被截获的票据最多在两个间隔后就失效。86400 是一天。仅在上面启用了会话票据时才有意义。

data.name: What stops one statement blocked on a lock from holding a worker thread for ever. Honoured at connect time by MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL; MS SQL and SQL CE start at ADO's own 30 seconds and pick this value up on any connection that has run an upgrade or maintenance script. Those scripts run under a 30-minute per-statement ceiling of their own regardless of this value. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 是什么阻止一条被锁阻塞的语句永远占用一个工作线程。MySQL/MariaDB 和 PostgreSQL 在连接时遵守它；MS SQL 和 SQL CE 从 ADO 自己的 30 秒开始，并在任何运行过升级或维护脚本的连接上采用此值。这些脚本无论此值如何，都在其自身每条语句 30 分钟的上限下运行。服务重启后生效。

data.name: What the server does as the message-store volume fills. Both values are absolute megabytes rather than percentages, because what decides whether the next message fits is how many bytes are left, not what fraction of the volume they are. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 邮件存储卷填满时服务器的做法。两个值都是绝对的兆字节而不是百分比，因为决定下一封邮件能否放下的是剩余多少字节，而不是它们占卷的比例。服务重启后生效。

data.name: What the server writes to its log files (viewable on the Live logs page).
data.value: 服务器写入其日志文件的内容 (可在“实时日志”页查看)。

data.name: What this key is for, e.g. "Grafana probe"
data.value: 此密钥的用途，例如 "Grafana probe"

data.name: What this server needs done outside it - DNS records, key and CA files, trusted lists. Each item shows a state; where the answer cannot be read from here, the item says what to check instead of guessing.
data.value: 本服务器需要在其外部完成的事项 - DNS 记录、密钥和 CA 文件、受信任列表。每一项都显示一个状态；无法从此处读取答案时，该项会说明要检查什么，而不是猜测。

data.name: What to do:
data.value: 要做的事:

data.name: Whatever your directory accepts for a simple bind: a UPN (svc-mail@example.local), DOMAIN\name, or a full DN. Left empty, the server searches anonymously - which usually fails against Active Directory, with a reported reason that names this setting.
data.value: 您的目录在简单绑定时接受的任何形式: UPN (svc-mail@example.local)、DOMAIN\name，或完整的 DN。留空时服务器会匿名搜索 - 这对 Active Directory 通常会失败，并报告一个指明此设置的原因。

data.name: When a DKIM signature was made, and when it stops being one a verifier should honour (RFC 6376 3.5).
data.value: DKIM 签名何时生成，以及何时不再是验证者应当认可的签名 (RFC 6376 3.5)。

data.name: When a scanner cannot run
data.value: 扫描器无法运行时

data.name: When a scanner finds something
data.value: 扫描器发现问题时

data.name: When a virus is found
data.value: 发现病毒时

data.name: When during the SMTP conversation blacklist lookups happen. Which blacklists are queried is on the DNS blacklists page.
data.value: 黑名单查询在 SMTP 会话的哪个时刻进行。查询哪些黑名单在“DNS 黑名单”页。

data.name: Where mail FROM this domain leaves through. This is a different question from a route, which decides where mail addressed TO a domain is sent - it is for a server hosting several independent domains where each has its own delivery provider.
data.value: 来自此域的邮件从哪里发出。这与路由是不同的问题，路由决定的是发往某个域的邮件送到哪里 - 这是为托管多个独立域、且每个域有自己的投递提供商的服务器准备的。

data.name: Where the administrator is told, well before anything is refused. 1024 MB is roughly fifty more maximum-size messages.
data.value: 在任何邮件被拒绝之前很久，管理员会在什么时候得到通知。1024 MB 大约相当于再多五十封最大尺寸的邮件。

data.name: Where the issued certificate would be written could not be determined, because neither the output folder above nor [Directories] DataFolder in hMailServer.INI could be read.
data.value: 无法确定已签发的证书会写到哪里，因为上面的输出文件夹和 hMailServer.INI 中的 [Directories] DataFolder 都无法读取。

data.name: Where the search starts, e.g. DC=example,DC=local. Required in search mode - that is, when the bind method is Simple and no DN template is set.
data.value: 搜索从哪里开始，例如 DC=example,DC=local。搜索模式下必填 - 也就是绑定方法为 Simple 且未设置 DN 模板时。

data.name: Where the server writes the logs configured above.
data.value: 服务器把上面配置的日志写到哪里。

data.name: Where this server stands
data.value: 本服务器的现状

data.name: Whether STARTTLS will be offered could not be determined: the TCP/IP ports and certificates could not be read. This listener borrows its certificate from a TLS-capable IMAP, POP3 or SMTP port and has none of its own.
data.value: 无法确定是否会提供 STARTTLS: 无法读取 TCP/IP 端口和证书。此监听器从支持 TLS 的 IMAP、POP3 或 SMTP 端口借用证书，自己没有证书。

data.name: Whether TLSA records exist, and whether your zone is DNSSEC-signed, can only be seen in DNS. If you have never set up DNSSEC for the zone, no TLSA record will validate.
data.value: 是否存在 TLSA 记录以及您的区域是否经过 DNSSEC 签名，只能在 DNS 中看到。如果您从未为该区域设置过 DNSSEC，任何 TLSA 记录都不会通过验证。

data.name: Whether a passphrase is stored could not be read - reading it requires the server-administrator account. Saving a new one from here still works.
data.value: 无法读取是否存储了密码短语 - 读取它需要服务器管理员账户。从此处保存新的密码短语仍然可以。

data.name: Whether lookups may be answered from the Windows DNS resolver cache. Off, every lookup goes to the network. Ignored when an override DNS server is set above — those lookups always bypass the system cache, because its answers would come from the wrong resolver.
data.value: 查询是否可以由 Windows DNS 解析器缓存应答。关闭时，每次查询都走网络。在上面设置了覆盖 DNS 服务器时会被忽略 — 那些查询总是绕过系统缓存，因为缓存的应答会来自错误的解析器。

data.name: Whether the key file needs one cannot be checked from here. If it is encrypted, it will not load without a passphrase (server error 6170) and the TLS ports using this certificate will not start.
data.value: 无法从此处检查密钥文件是否需要密码短语。如果它已加密，没有密码短语就不会加载 (服务器错误 6170)，使用此证书的 TLS 端口也不会启动。

data.name: Whether this port is being listened on could not be determined from here. Open the Control Panel on the server itself to see it.
data.value: 无法从此处确定此端口是否正在被监听。请在服务器本身上打开控制面板查看。

data.name: Which TLS versions and ciphers this server negotiates, for its own listeners and for the connections it makes when delivering. Certificates are on the SSL certificates page; DANE and MTA-STS are on Transport security; brute-force lockout is on Auto-ban.
data.value: 本服务器为自己的监听器以及投递时建立的连接协商哪些 TLS 版本和密码套件。证书在“SSL 证书”页；DANE 和 MTA-STS 在“传输安全”页；暴力破解锁定在“自动封禁”页。

data.name: Which TLS versions and ciphers this server will negotiate, and whether it verifies the certificate of the server it delivers to.
data.value: 本服务器将协商哪些 TLS 版本和密码套件，以及它是否验证所投递服务器的证书。

data.name: Which Windows account the hMailServer service logs on as. By default that is LocalSystem - the most privileged account on the machine - so a flaw reachable through SMTP, IMAP or POP3 is reachable with full control of the computer. Running the service as a dedicated account is the single largest reduction in what a compromise is worth, and the recommended one is the password-less virtual account NT SERVICE\hMailServer.
data.value: hMailServer 服务以哪个 Windows 账户登录。默认是 LocalSystem - 机器上权限最高的账户 - 因此通过 SMTP、IMAP 或 POP3 可触及的缺陷，就是以对计算机的完全控制权可触及的。以专用账户运行服务是降低被攻陷所值代价的最大单项措施，推荐使用无密码的虚拟账户 NT SERVICE\hMailServer。

data.name: Which addresses may connect, which may relay without authenticating, and which must authenticate first.
data.value: 哪些地址可以连接，哪些可以不经身份验证中继，哪些必须先通过身份验证。

data.name: Which attribute holds the mailbox address. proxyAddresses is understood: its scheme prefix is removed and the primary SMTP: value is preferred over the lower-case aliases.
data.value: 哪个属性保存邮箱地址。proxyAddresses 会被理解: 其方案前缀会被去掉，主 SMTP: 值优先于小写的别名。

data.name: Which attribute holds the name the person logs in with. This is what is stored against the account and what the directory is asked about at every logon afterwards, so guessing it from the address is not good enough - an entry that does not carry it is reported rather than provisioned.
data.value: 哪个属性保存此人用于登录的名称。它会被存到账户上，并在此后每次登录时向目录询问，因此仅凭地址猜测是不够的 - 不带该属性的条目会被报告，而不是被预配。

data.name: Which deliveries are allowed from this range
data.value: 此范围允许哪些投递

data.name: Which directory entries become mailboxes
data.value: 哪些目录条目会成为邮箱

data.name: Which domain to synchronise
data.value: 要同步哪个域

data.name: Which log files the server writes, how much detail they carry, and how long they are kept.
data.value: 服务器写哪些日志文件、包含多少细节以及保留多久。

data.name: Which name servers the server asks, and whether answers are DNSSEC validated.
data.value: 服务器向哪些名称服务器查询，以及应答是否经过 DNSSEC 验证。

data.name: Which resolver hMailServer queries. Leave empty to use the name servers Windows is configured with. The override takes a single IPv4 address and is used on port 53; DNSSEC validation and its trust anchors are on the Transport security page.
data.value: hMailServer 查询哪个解析器。留空则使用 Windows 配置的名称服务器。覆盖项接受单个 IPv4 地址并使用端口 53；DNSSEC 验证及其信任锚在“传输安全”页。

data.name: Which scanners can actually run, what size of message is scanned, and what happens to one that is found to be infected.
data.value: 哪些扫描器真正能运行、扫描多大的邮件，以及被发现受感染的邮件会怎样。

data.name: Which scanners can actually run, what they are asked to look at, and what happens to a message one of them condemns. Nothing on this page can be edited — each row opens the page that owns the setting.
data.value: 哪些扫描器真正能运行、要求它们查看什么，以及被其中某个扫描器判定有问题的邮件会怎样。本页无法编辑任何内容 — 每一行都会打开拥有该设置的页面。

data.name: Which services are running, who is connected right now, and how long the server has been up.
data.value: 哪些服务在运行、此刻谁已连接，以及服务器已运行多久。

data.name: Which services listen, on what, and how clients reach them.
data.value: 哪些服务在监听、监听什么，以及客户端如何访问它们。

data.name: Which services this server runs, connection limits and greetings.
data.value: 本服务器运行哪些服务、连接限制和问候语。

data.name: Which spelling of the DMARC aggregate report goes out to the domains this server reports on. 1 is what every report consumer deployed today parses; 2 is DMARCbis, for the day the consumers have caught up. Any other value is reported as an error and treated as 1, because a typo must not decide what goes on the wire. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: DMARC 汇总报告以哪种写法发往本服务器所报告的域。1 是当今部署的每个报告消费者都能解析的；2 是 DMARCbis，留给消费者跟上的那一天。任何其他值都会被报告为错误并按 1 处理，因为拼写错误不应决定线路上发出的内容。服务重启后生效。

data.name: White list
data.value: 白名单

data.name: White-list the sender or their IP range so the message bypasses spam protection.
data.value: 把发件人或其 IP 范围加入白名单，使邮件绕过垃圾邮件防护。

data.name: Who may connect, who may authenticate, and what happens when someone keeps trying.
data.value: 谁可以连接、谁可以进行身份验证，以及有人不断尝试时会发生什么。

data.name: Wildcard
data.value: 通配符

data.name: Will not start
data.value: 不会启动

data.name: Windows Event Log
data.value: Windows 事件日志

data.name: Windows _domain (leave empty for a local Windows account)
data.value: Windows 域(_D) (本地 Windows 账户请留空)

data.name: Windows _user name
data.value: Windows 用户名(_U)

data.name: Windows display language
data.value: Windows 显示语言

data.name: Windows does not report an hMailServer service on this machine, so there is no service to re-register yet.
data.value: Windows 没有报告本机上有 hMailServer 服务，因此还没有可重新注册的服务。

data.name: Windows does not report an hMailServer service on this machine, so there is nothing for this setting to apply to yet. It is read when the service is registered.
data.value: Windows 没有报告本机上有 hMailServer 服务，因此此设置还没有可应用的对象。它在服务注册时读取。

data.name: Windows service account
data.value: Windows 服务账户

data.name: Windows service account - a least-privilege account needs granting outside hMailServer
data.value: Windows 服务账户 - 最小权限账户需要在 hMailServer 之外授予权限

data.name: Windows: an inbound block rule per banned address in Windows Defender Firewall, TCP only and scoped to the ports this server listens on, in a rule group named hMailServer auto-ban; removed when the ban expires or the IP range is deleted. Linux: the packaged autoban-hook keeps an nftables set with a timeout, and the service needs CAP_NET_ADMIN for it - the hook says exactly how to grant it. List the addresses you administer from under never-ban first.
data.value: Windows：在 Windows Defender Firewall 中为每个被封禁的地址创建一条入站阻止规则，仅限 TCP，并且只针对本服务器监听的端口，放在名为 hMailServer auto-ban 的规则组中；封禁到期或 IP 范围被删除时该规则即被移除。Linux：随包提供的 autoban-hook 维护一个带超时的 nftables 集合，服务为此需要 CAP_NET_ADMIN，hook 会准确说明如何授予。请先把您用于管理的地址加入“永不封禁”。

data.name: With a moderator set, a sender the rules above refuse is forwarded to the moderator instead of being rejected. The moderator approves by resending the message to the list from an authenticated session.
data.value: 设置了审核人时，被上面规则拒绝的发件人会被转给审核人而不是被拒绝。审核人通过从已验证的会话把邮件重新发送到列表来批准。

data.name: With this on, MAIL FROM in an authenticated session must be the account's own address, an alias that resolves to it, or another mailbox whose owner has granted the account the post (p) right on their INBOX - which is how Send-As for a shared mailbox is granted, from any IMAP client's ACL editor (SETACL) or over the COM API. Anything else is refused with 550 5.7.1 before a byte of the message is accepted, so one compromised or careless account can no longer send as every other. Off by default because nothing constrained this before and an installation may depend on that; the null sender is always allowed. Unauthenticated sessions are unaffected. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: 开启后，已验证会话中的 MAIL FROM 必须是账户自己的地址、解析到它的别名，或所有者已向该账户授予其 INBOX 上投递 (p) 权限的另一个邮箱 - 共享邮箱的“代表发送”就是这样授予的，可通过任何 IMAP 客户端的 ACL 编辑器 (SETACL) 或通过 COM API。其他任何情况都会在接受邮件的第一个字节之前以 550 5.7.1 拒绝，因此一个被攻陷或粗心的账户再也不能冒充所有其他账户发送。默认关闭，因为以前没有任何东西限制这一点，现有安装可能依赖它；空发件人始终允许。未验证的会话不受影响。服务重启后生效。

data.name: With this on, an account's own vacation message still answers colleagues, but outside senders get the domain's generic text instead - so personal detail in a vacation message stays inside the organisation.
data.value: 开启后，账户自己的休假消息仍会回复同事，但外部发件人会收到域的通用文本 - 这样休假消息中的个人细节就留在了组织内部。

data.name: With this on, the password is not stored here at all - Windows is asked to check it. Leave it off and the account uses the password on the Account tab.
data.value: 开启后，密码根本不存储在这里 - 而是请 Windows 来检查它。保持关闭，账户就使用“账户”选项卡上的密码。

data.name: Work out whether accepting or delivering has stalled, turn on the logging that names the cause, and read the lines that do.
data.value: 弄清楚是接收还是投递停滞了，开启指明原因的日志，然后阅读指明原因的那些行。

data.name: Work out which half has stalled - accepting or delivering - turn on the logging that names the cause, and read the lines that do.
data.value: 弄清楚是哪一半停滞了 - 接收还是投递 - 开启指明原因的日志，然后阅读指明原因的那些行。

data.name: Worker thread priority (stored, but the server does not use it)
data.value: 工作线程优先级 (已存储，但服务器不使用它)

data.name: Worth knowing about this configuration
data.value: 关于此配置值得了解的事

data.name: Write a Received-SPF header on inbound mail
data.value: 在入站邮件上写入 Received-SPF 标头

data.name: Write a separate log file per service component
data.value: 为每个服务组件写入单独的日志文件

data.name: Write an Authentication-Results header on inbound mail
data.value: 在入站邮件上写入 Authentication-Results 标头

data.name: Write logs as JSON lines
data.value: 以 JSON 行的形式写入日志

data.name: Write operational events to the Windows Application log
data.value: 把运行事件写入 Windows 应用程序日志

data.name: Write-only: a stored password is never shown here again - leave the box blank to keep it. It is stored as plain text in hMailServer.INI on the server, because the server has to present it to the directory verbatim and so cannot hash it; restrict file access to the INI accordingly. It only ever leaves the server over the transport configured above.
data.value: 只写：已存储的密码绝不会再在此处显示 - 把框留空即可保留它。它以纯文本形式存储在服务器上的 hMailServer.INI 中，因为服务器必须原样把它出示给目录，所以无法对它做哈希；请相应地限制对该 INI 文件的访问权限。它只会通过上面配置的传输方式离开服务器。

data.name: Writes the conditions an operator alerts on - database unavailable, a listener that would not start, a crash, a failed backup, the disk floor - to the Windows Application log, where Event Viewer, monitoring agents and SIEM collectors can see them. Stable event ids (the table lives in WindowsEventLog.h); a healthy server writes nothing at all. Protocol traffic and routine logging never go here - a mail server that logs every session to the Application log gets itself uninstalled.
data.value: 把运维人员会据以告警的情况 - 数据库不可用、无法启动的监听器、崩溃、失败的备份、磁盘下限 - 写入 Windows 应用程序日志，事件查看器、监控代理和 SIEM 收集器都能在那里看到它们。事件 id 是稳定的（对照表位于 WindowsEventLog.h）；健康的服务器什么都不会写。协议流量和常规日志绝不会写到这里 - 一台把每个会话都记入应用程序日志的邮件服务器，最后会把自己搞到被卸载。

data.name: hMailServer does NOT implement CalDAV or CardDAV. These settings only answer the well-known discovery URLs (RFC 6764) with a redirect to the server that does, so a client configured with a user's mail address finds their calendar without being told a second address. Leave both empty unless you run such a server: empty means the discovery URLs answer 404, which is the honest response when there is nothing to point at. They need the web services listener above to be running, like everything else on this page.
data.value: hMailServer 并不实现 CalDAV 或 CardDAV。这些设置只是用一个指向确实实现了它们的服务器的重定向来应答众所周知的发现 URL（RFC 6764），这样用用户邮件地址配置好的客户端不必再被告知第二个地址就能找到其日历。除非您确实运行着这样一台服务器，否则请把两者都留空：留空意味着发现 URL 应答 404，而在没有任何可指向的目标时，这才是诚实的回应。与本页上的其他一切一样，它们需要上面的 Web 服务监听器处于运行状态。

data.name: hMailServer does not create or manage client certificates. The certificate authority and the client certificates themselves must be produced outside hMailServer (for example with OpenSSL or an internal PKI) - the server only trusts the CA bundle it is given here.
data.value: hMailServer 既不创建也不管理客户端证书。证书颁发机构和客户端证书本身都必须在 hMailServer 之外产生（例如使用 OpenSSL 或内部 PKI）- 服务器只信任此处提供给它的 CA 证书包。

data.name: hMailServer.ini setting BackupVerifyRestore, on by default. After the archive is written its message store is extracted to the temp folder through the same code a restore uses, held to exactly the files the backup staged, and every message row is checked for its file; the result is in the backup log. The store exists twice while it runs, so turn it off for a store the temp volume cannot hold. Applies after a service restart.
data.value: hMailServer.ini 设置 BackupVerifyRestore，默认开启。存档写入之后，会通过还原所用的同一套代码把它的邮件存储解压到临时文件夹，严格限定为备份所暂存的那些文件，并逐条检查每一行邮件记录是否有对应的文件；结果记录在备份日志中。运行期间存储会同时存在两份，因此对于临时卷容纳不下的存储请关闭它。在重启服务后生效。

data.name: p=none is the right starting point, not an oversight: it makes receivers check and report but deliver as normal. A stricter policy (quarantine or reject) tells every receiver to junk or refuse mail that fails alignment - and until reports show your own mail passing SPF or DKIM, the mail that fails will include yours. Tighten only after the reports say it is safe.
data.value: p=none 是正确的起点，而不是疏漏：它让接收方进行检查并发送报告，但照常投递。更严格的策略（quarantine 或 reject）会告诉每一个接收方把对齐失败的邮件丢进垃圾箱或直接拒收 - 而在报告显示您自己的邮件能通过 SPF 或 DKIM 之前，失败的邮件里就会有您自己的。只有在报告说安全之后再收紧。

data.value: {0}：该端口有客户端证书策略，却没有 SSL/TLS 或 STARTTLS，因此永远不会发生握手{1} 请在该端口上启用连接安全，或者把该策略设为关闭。

data.name: {0}: the rotation record at {1} is published and matches the staged secondary key. Promote whenever it has propagated everywhere.
data.value: {0}：{1} 处的轮换记录已发布，并且与暂存的次要密钥相符。等它在各处都传播完成后即可提升。

data.name: {0}: the secondary key is staged but no TXT record exists at {1} yet. Publish it and let it propagate BEFORE promoting the secondary key, or mail will sign with a key the world cannot look up.
data.value: {0}：次要密钥已暂存，但 {1} 处还没有 TXT 记录。请在提升次要密钥之前发布它并让它完成传播，否则邮件会用一个全世界都查不到的密钥来签名。

data.name: {0}: the {1} TXT record is published. Not checkable from here: that mta-sts.{2} resolves to this server, and that the certificate covers that name.
data.value: {0}：{1} TXT 记录已发布。无法从此处检查的是：mta-sts.{2} 是否解析到本服务器，以及证书是否覆盖该名称。

data.name: {0}: {1} contains no PEM certificate block, so it holds no usable CA certificate (server error 6140). Export the CA certificate in PEM (Base64) format.
data.value: {0}：{1} 不包含任何 PEM 证书块，因此它没有可用的 CA 证书（服务器错误 6140）。请以 PEM（Base64）格式导出该 CA 证书。

data.name: {0}{1} anti-virus turned off, so mail collected by {2} delivered unscanned no matter what is set here. The switch is on the fetch account, not on this page.{3}
